Alg.Name: Comprosso
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Holy Grail of compressor pedals is here.
Comprosso is based on the legendary Ross™ Compressor* pedal, which is unarguably the compressor of compressors. We carefully recreated the sonic character to get the same colorful, bouncy, natural compression as the original pedal.

Controls:

Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Output: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Comprosso 音色基于传奇压缩单块—— Ross™ Compressor* ，有着自然、温暖、甜蜜、弹性十足的压缩音色和标志性的超长延音。

参数控制： 

Sustain： 调节压缩量
Output： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于传奇压缩单块 Ross™ Compressor* 。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Ross™ Compressor* pedal.

Alg.Name: Comparoma 4
Alg.descriptionEN:
The wonderful aroma of compression. Based on the famous Keeley® C4 4-knob compressor* pedal, the Comparoma 4 delivers a silky, bouncy, studio grade compression sound.

Controls:

Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal 
Output: Controls the effect output 
Clipping: Controls the input sensitivity 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Comparoma 4 是一个音色基于著名的 Keeley® C4 4-knob compressor* 的压缩效果。作为业界标杆级别的压缩单块， Keeley® C4* 的鼎鼎大名无需赘述。这款 Comparoma 4 保留了原版独特的“风味”，它有着自然、顺滑、弹性极佳的录音室级别压缩音色。

参数控制： 

Sustain： 调节效果的压缩量
Output： 调节效果的输出音量
Attack： 调节压缩效果器多久开始处理声音信号
Clipping： 调节输入灵敏度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Keeley® C4 4-knob compressor* 的压缩效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Keeley® C4 4-knob compressor* pedal.

Alg.Name: Blue Sustainer
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Blue Sustainer is based on the legendary 3-knob compressor/sustainer pedal, which produces warm, natural compression with long sustain and some gentle clipping. 

Controls:

Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal 
Output: Controls the effect output 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Blue Sustainer 基于一个经典的三旋钮VCA压缩/延音  （Compression/Sustainer） 单块建模而来，它可以带来温暖、自然的压缩音色，并且伴随着悦耳的轻微失真和绵长的延音。

参数控制： 

Sustain： 调节压缩量/延音长度
Attack： 调节压缩音头明显程度
Output： 调节效果的输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一个经典的三旋钮VCA压缩/延音单块建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary 3-knob compressor/sustainer pedal.

Alg.Name: Squeezer
Alg.descriptionEN:
A compressor effect reduces the dynamic range of your signal and makes your sound much stronger. The Squeezer is a fully-functional compressor with lots of tonal flexibility. A Tone knob is specially designed for further tone shaping.

Controls:

Threshold: Controls the compression trigger level 
Ratio: Controls the amount of compression when the compressor is triggered
Output:
Controls the output volume/makeup amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal
Release: Controls how soon the compressor starts to release the signal level back to normal after the level drops below the threshold
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Alg.descriptionCN:
Squeezer 是一个功能齐全的压缩效果，适用于多种场合。丰富的参数调节可以为您带来高品质、高可塑性的压缩音色。

参数控制： 

Threshold： 调节压缩触发的阈值
Ratio： 调节压缩比
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Attack： 调节压缩效果起始时间
Release： 调节压缩释放时间
Tone： 调节压缩音色明亮度
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
Alg.desInforCN: 一个功能齐全的压缩效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Squeezer is a fully-functional compressor with lots of tonal flexibility.

Alg.Name: Affinity Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Affinity Boost pumps up that sweet sound you've found in your amp. Based on the famous Xotic® AC Booster* pedal, it serves up a wide ranged sound character with power and sensitivity. Or use it as an overdrive to get a sweet, classic tube-like drive with a "wide open" feel.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Affinity Boost 基于著名的 Xotic® AC Booster* 建模，为您的弹奏注入更多的能量。 Treble/Bass 两段均衡可以满足您对于音色的多种需求。同时，您也可以单独把 Affinity Boost 当一个过载使用，它可以带来甜美宽广的电子管过载之声。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 调节低频/高频量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Xotic® AC Booster* 建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Xotic® AC Booster* pedal.

Alg.Name: Beefy Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
If you're going to have a steak, you want it big and juicy. The Beefy Boost is based on the classic Xotic® BB Preamp* pedal. It serves up a wide ranged sound character, giving you a boost of encouraging lows and inspiring highs. Or use it as an overdrive to get a thick, juicy "overdriven steak" with a little compression. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Beefy Boost 是一个基于 Xotic® BB Preamp* 的过载/激励效果。您可以把它当一个过载来用，此时您可以获得一个肥厚并带有一点压缩感的过载音色；您也可以把它当激励来用，带来更好的动态与频响范围。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 调节低频/高频量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Xotic® BB Preamp* 的过载/激励效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the classic Xotic® BB Preamp* pedal.

Alg.Name: Pristine Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Pristine Boost features a unique "no character" character. Based on the famous Xotic® RC Booster* pedal, it offers a super transparent clean boost and a powerful active 2-band EQ so you can maintain your original tonal flavor. Simply put it in your pedal chain, tune up, and leave it on!

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Pristine Boost 是一个原声激励效果，基于 Xotic® RC Booster* 单块建模。它可以提供高达20dB的激励幅度，附带的两段主动均衡能够提供±15dB的高低频增益调节范围。您如果将它放在效果链的前端，让它保持常开，它为您带来的音色提升可能就让您再也不想关掉它了。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 调节低频/高频量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Xotic® RC Booster* 原声激励效果单块建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Xotic® RC Booster* pedal.

Alg.Name: Forest Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Forest Boost is based on the Fortin® Grind* booster pedal, providing a max. +20dB boost amount. It helps tighten up your tone while adding some aggressive edges. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the effect output/boost amount

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Forest Boost 是一款原声激励效果，基于 Fortin® Grind* 激励单块建模，有着最大20dB的增益量。它可以使您的音色的低频变得更加紧实、中高频变得更加凶狠。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量/输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fortin® Grind* 激励单块建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Fortin® Grind* booster pedal.

Alg.Name: Treble Ranger
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on one of the world's most iconic effect units: the Dallas Rangemaster™* Treble Booster. Born in 1965, the unit was intended to work as a preamp to get the guitarist more gain and treble. Connect it to a dark UK-style amp, plug in an LP-style guitar, and you get the magical tone the 1960s UK guitar heroes depended on.  

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Treble Ranger 是一款高频激励效果，基于 Dallas Rangemaster™*  激励效果器建模。为了给当时的吉他手带来更多高频以及更多增益，这款效果器在1965年被设计出来。如果您有一把LP型吉他，还有一台音色比较闷的英式音箱，搭配上本效果使用之后您就可以感受到它带来的音色魅力了

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量/输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Dallas Rangemaster™*  激励效果器建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Dallas Rangemaster™* Treble Booster.

Alg.Name: Gated Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
Our Gated Boost is designed for modern Dentlemen and metalheads who need huge gain buy not noisy artifacts. A built-in noise gate reduces hum and keeps your palm muting tight. Use the Low Cut knob to get your tone where you want it. 

Controls:

Boost: Controls the boost amount 
Gate: Controls the noise gate threshold
Low Cut: Cuts the low frequency signal
Alg.descriptionCN:
Gated Boost 是一款专门为现代金属乐手/前卫乐手/ Djent 乐手设计的激励效果，它有着极大的增益幅度，同时不会改变您原本的音色； Low Cut 旋钮可以有效控制过于肥厚的低频，使音色更紧凑。 Gated Boost 内置了一个灵敏度很高的噪音门，可以有效抑制高增益失真带来的噪音，同时它超快的响应速度也可以使您在 Djent 风格的制音演奏中得到您想要的效果。

参数控制： 

Boost： 调节效果增益量
Gate： 调节噪音门触发阈值
Low Cut： 调节低频衰减程度
Alg.desInforCN: 专门为现代金属乐手/前卫乐手/ Djent 乐手设计的激励效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Designed for modern Dentlemen and metalheads.

Alg.Name: Micro Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Micro Boost is based on the legendary MXR® M133 Micro Amp* pedal. Providing up to 20dB of gain, the Micro Boost elevates your amp sound without changing its tonal character. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Micro Boost 是一款激励效果，基于 MXR® M133 Micro Amp* 经典激励单块建模。它有着最大20dB的增益量，可以在有效提升输出信号幅度的同时不改变原始音色风味。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量/输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 MXR® M133 Micro Amp* 经典激励单块建模
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary MXR® M133 Micro Amp* pedal.

Alg.Name: Creamy
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a special tone simulator that simulates the legendary "Woman Tone" created by Eric Clapton during his Cream years. The tone is thick, sustaining, kazoo-like but maintaining note definition and enough attack. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the thickness
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个特殊的音色模拟效果，再现了 Eric Clapton 在 Cream 时期标志性的 Woman Tone 音色。它有着像卡祖笛一样的绵绸、悠长、厚实的声音，同时音色不失清晰。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量/音色
Alg.desInforCN: 再现Eric Clapton在Cream时期标志性的 Woman Tone音色。
Alg.desInforEN: A tone simulator that simulates the legendary "Woman Tone".

Alg.Name: FET Boost
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the legendary FET-based belt clip preamp, this FET boost is a clean volume machine. Use this pedal to get a huge amount of gain without any distortion, tone sculpt with the flexible 2-band EQ. Onboard you'll also find a handy low cut filter for tone shaping and eliminating low frequency feedback.

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Low Cut: Switches the low cut filter (-6dB/oct @200Hz) on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
FET Boost 的音色基于一个传奇的腰挂式前级效果器。作为众多乐手（比如 U2 的 The Edge） 的秘密武器，它将带给您干净饱满的原声激励效果。和原版一样， FET Boost 有着高达26dB的最大增益量并且不会出现失真；并且灵活多变的两段均衡和低切滤波器开关可以让您对音色进行细致塑形或是抑制低频啸叫。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节增益量/输出音量
Bass/Treble： 调节低频/高频量
Low Cut： 打开或关闭低切滤波器 （-6dB/oct @200Hz）
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一个传奇的腰挂式前级效果器的原声激励效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary FET-based belt clip preamp.

Alg.Name: Enhancer
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Enhancer is based on the Xotic® EP Booster* pedal. This pure booster is the key to unlocking MASTER sounds. With expanded frequency response and increased dynamic range, this pedal enhances the vitality of everything you run into it.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the effect output/boost amount
+3dB: Selects the minimum boost amount from 0dB (off) to +3dB (on)
Bright: Selects the sound character from vintage (Bright off) to flat (Bright on)

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Enhancer 是一款原声激励效果，基于 Xotic® EP Booster* 单块建模，它可以有效提升您音色的频响和动态，是众多大师音色中不可或缺的秘密武器之一。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节增益量/输出音量
+3dB： 选择最小增益是0dB还是+3dB
Bright： 打开以增加额外的高频，关闭以保持平直频响

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Xotic® EP Booster* 单块建模的原声激励效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Xotic® EP Booster* pedal.

Alg.Name: AI Gate
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on the famous ISP® Decimator™* noise gate pedal. Like the original, the extremely easy-to-use noise gate gets you smooth, ripple-free noise tracking and keeps your signal pristine. 

Controls: 

Threshold: Controls the gate trigger level 
Side Chain: Selects side chain key input source; please set this parameter carefully to match the actual input you're using, or the device may be MUTED: 
-Input L/R: Input jacks
-FX RTN L/R: FX Loop return jack
-Prev FX: Output signal of previous effect slot; if you select this, we recommend you to place the gate before amp/drive effects
-USB OUT 3-8: USB output 3-8; when reamping, set up according to the USB output channel you're using

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这个降噪效果基于著名的 ISP® Decimator™* 噪音门单块。它能够敏锐地捕捉并且消除噪声，降噪过程平滑、自然，不会对您原来的音色造成影响；单一参数设计免除了乐手调参数的烦恼。

参数控制： 

Threshold ： 调节噪音门的触发阈值
Side Chain： 选择噪音门侧链控制的探测信号源，请注意如果该参数设置与您实际使用的输入源不匹配时可能会导致您的设备无声： 
-Input L/R： 左/右输入接口
-FX RTN L/R： 效果回路返回左/右声道
-Prev FX：  前一个效果槽的输出信号；当您在使用这一选项时，我们推荐将噪音门放在失真/过载/音箱模拟类效果前
-USB Out 3-8： USB输出3-8， 如果您需要进行Reamp，请将此参数值设置为自己实际使用的USB输出通道

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 ISP® Decimator™* 噪音门单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous ISP® Decimator™* noise gate pedal.

Alg.Name: Fast Gate
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 2-mode noise gate with fast response, which is great for modern Djentlemen and metalheads.  

Controls: 

Threshold: Controls the gate trigger level 
Mode: Selects from two modes: I (responds faster)/II (responds smoother)
Side Chain: Selects side chain key input source; please set this parameter carefully to match the actual input you're using, or the device may be MUTED: 
-Input L/R: Input jacks
-FX RTN L/R: FX Loop return jack
-Prev FX: Output signal of previous effect slot; if you select this, we recommend you to place the gate before amp/drive effects
-USB OUT 3-8: USB output 3-8; when reamping, set up according to the USB output channel you're using
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个反应灵敏的降噪效果，可以在很短的时间内快速启动消除底噪并且不会影响您的音色，非常适合用于重型音乐。

参数控制： 

Threshold： 调节噪音门的触发阈值
Mode： 选择噪音门的工作模式： 
-I： 有着最快的响应速度
-II： 有着相对较慢、更平滑自然的响应
Side Chain： 选择噪音门侧链控制的探测信号源，请注意如果该参数设置与您实际使用的输入源不匹配时可能会导致您的设备无声： 
-Input L/R： 左/右输入接口
-FX RTN L/R： 效果回路返回左/右声道
-Prev FX：  前一个效果槽的输出信号；当您在使用这一选项时，我们推荐将噪音门放在失真/过载/音箱模拟类效果前
-USB Out 3-8： USB输出3-8， 如果您需要进行Reamp，请将此参数值设置为自己实际使用的USB输出通道
Alg.desInforCN: 一个反应灵敏的降噪效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 2-mode noise gate with fast response.

Alg.Name: Custom Gate
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a fully-functional noise gate with detailed control. The individual Attack and Release controls play nice with amps and other pedals. 

Controls: 

Threshold: Controls the gate trigger level 
Attack: Controls how soon the gate starts to process the signal
Release: Controls the noise fade-out duration time after the level drops below the threshold
Side Chain: Selects side chain key input source; please set this parameter carefully to match the actual input you're using, or the device may be MUTED: 
-Input L/R: Input jacks
-FX RTN L/R: FX Loop return jack
-Prev FX: Output signal of previous effect slot; if you select this, we recommend you to place the gate before amp/drive effects
-USB OUT 3-8: USB output 3-8; when reamping, set up according to the USB output channel you're using
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个可调范围丰富的降噪效果，您可以自由调节参数以满足个人需求。

参数控制： 

Threshold： 调节噪音门的触发阈值
Attack： 选择噪音门的起始时间
Release： 选择噪音门的释放时间
Side Chain： 选择噪音门侧链控制的探测信号源，请注意如果该参数设置与您实际使用的输入源不匹配时可能会导致您的设备无声： 
-Input L/R： 左/右输入接口
-FX RTN L/R： 效果回路返回左/右声道
-Prev FX：  前一个效果槽的输出信号；当您在使用这一选项时，我们推荐将噪音门放在失真/过载/音箱模拟类效果前
-USB Out 3-8： USB输出3-8， 如果您需要进行Reamp，请将此参数值设置为自己实际使用的USB输出通道
Alg.desInforCN: 一个可调范围丰富的降噪效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a fully-functional noise gate with detailed control.

Alg.Name: Acoustic Refiner
Alg.descriptionEN:
Enjoy acoustic refinement: This one-knob tool enhances all that is good in acoustic guitars. It gives a more natural, "woody" tone to your plugged-in acoustic sound, doing wonders for piezo pickups! One knob makes it simple.

Controls:

Shape: Controls the detailed effect character
Alg.descriptionCN:
Acoustic Refiner 特别为压电式拾音器设计，可以为您的电箱琴提供更自然的箱体共鸣音色。简单易用的单旋钮设计能有效帮助您专注于演奏。

参数控制： 

Shape： 控制效果音色细节
Alg.desInforCN: 为压电式拾音器的电箱琴提供更自然的箱体共鸣音色。

Alg.Name: AC Sim
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is an acoustic simulator designed for electric guitars that provides an adjustable range wide enough to give an ordinary electric guitar a variety of natural and realistic acoustic tones.

Controls:

Body: Controls the "body resonance" (low frequency response)
Top: Controls the upper harmonics (high frequency response)
Volume: Controls the effect output level
Mode: Selects from 4 different sound characters:
-Standard: Simulates the tonal characteristics of a standard acoustic guitar
-Jumbo: Simulates the tonal characteristics of a jumbo acoustic guitar 
-Enhanced: Simulates the tonal characteristics of an acoustic guitar with enhanced attack
-Piezo: Simulates the sound of a piezo pickup
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个专为电吉他打造的箱琴模拟效果，让一把普通的电吉他也可以拥有逼真的木吉他音色，四种模式和  Body/Top 调节带来了宽广的音色调节范围。

参数控制： 

Body： 控制原声吉他模拟的箱体共振
Top： 调节原声吉他的高频泛音和触弦音色
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Mode： 选择音色模式
-Standard： 模拟标准的木吉他音色
-Jumbo： 模拟 Jumbo 型箱琴音色    
-Enhanced： 有着更多泛音、更强音头的木吉他音色
-Piezo： 模拟琴桥压电拾音器音色
Alg.desInforCN: 一个专为电吉他打造的箱琴模拟效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This is an acoustic simulator designed for electric guitars.

Alg.Name: Low Pass
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a low pass filter that lets the lows go and attenuates the highs. 

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency 
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个低通滤波器效果，用于切除设定频点以上的高频信号。

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器截止频率
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 低通滤波器效果。

Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output

这是一个带通滤波器效果，用于衰减以某一频点为中心一定范围以外的信号。

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率

Level： 调节效果输出音量

Alg.Name: High Pass

This is a high pass filter that lets the highs go and attenuates lows.

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB

Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output

Gain： 调节滤波器增益

Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 高通滤波器效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A high pass filter.

Alg.Name: Notch
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a notch filter that boosts/cuts selected frequency range. The filter shape is very narrow so you can use it to accurately eliminate unwanted feedback or fine tune your tone. 

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个陷波（Notch）滤波器效果，该滤波器带宽很窄，用于精确衰减或提升以某一频点为中心一定范围的信号，可以用于消除舞台音箱啸叫或精确修饰音色。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 陷波（Notch）滤波器效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A notch filter.

Alg.Name: Peak
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a peak filter that boosts/cuts a certain frequency range. Like a frequency band on a parametric EQ, this model is great tool for tone shaping.   

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个峰值 （Peak） 滤波器效果，该滤波器带宽调节范围较大，用于整体衰减或提升以某一频点为中心一定范围的信号，作用类似参量均衡 （Parametric EQ） 的某一个频段调节功能。

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 峰值（Peak）滤波器效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A peak filter.

Alg.Name: Low Shelf
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a low shelf filter that boosts/cuts signal below a set frequency which is great for effectively boosting/eliminating low ends. 

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个搁架式 （Shelf） 滤波器效果，用于整体衰减或提升设定频点以下的低频。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量

Alg.Name: High Shelf
Alg.descriptionEN:

Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output

Alg.Name: Tilt EQ
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a tilt filter, a quick tool for tone sculpting. Like a seesaw, it boosts the signal above a set frequency and cuts the signal below it, or vice versa. 

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the filter gain by ±12dB
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个倾斜 （Tilt） 滤波器效果，用于整体衰减设定频点以下的频率的同时提升设定频点以上的频率，或反其道而行之。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节滤波器增益
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 倾斜（Tilt）滤波器效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A tilt filter.

Alg.Name: Moo VCF LP
Alg.descriptionEN:

Controls: 

Cutoff: Controls the cutoff frequency
Reso: Controls the filter resonance
Level: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个低通滤波器效果，音色灵感来源基于著名的 Moog® VCF* （Voltage-Controlled Filter，压控滤波器），用于切除设定频点以上的高频信号。

参数控制： 

Cutoff： 调节滤波器截止频率
Reso： 调节滤波器共振峰
Level： 调节效果输出音量
*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。

Alg.Name: Toucher G
Alg.descriptionEN:
Toucher G is an envelope filter designed for guitars, offering you a wide range of tonal variety. Set the Sense, Range, and Q parameters to fit your instrument and playing style. 

Controls:

Sense: Controls the effect sensitivity
Range: Controls the filter frequency range 
Q: Controls the filter sharpness
Level: Controls the output level
Alg.descriptionCN:
Toucher G 是一个为吉他设计的包络滤波器（或称为 Touch Wah）效果，音色会跟着您演奏力度的不同而发生变化。Toucher G 有着丰富的控制参数，可以帮助您玩出不同的花样。

参数控制： 

Sens： 调节灵敏度，参数值越高灵敏度越高
Range： 调节哇音滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节哇音滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 为吉他设计的包络滤波器（或称为 Touch Wah）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Toucher G is an envelope filter designed for guitars.

Alg.descriptionEN:
This is an envelope filter inspired by the legendary Moog® VCF*. This is a lot of fun to use with synths, and it's also great on guitar/bass to create something synth-y.

Controls: 

Sense: Controls the sensitivity
Mode: Controls the filter mode
Freq: Controls the filter center frequency
Q: Controls the filter Q
Dry Level: Controls the dry signal amount
Level: Controls the effect output

Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个包络滤波器 （Envelope Filter） 效果，音色灵感来源基于著名的 Moog® VCF*（Voltage-Controlled Filter，压控滤波器），可以创造类似合成器的音色。该效果有着丰富的参数，您可以对效果最终呈现的音色进行详细调节。

参数控制： 

Sense： 调节灵敏度，参数值越高灵敏度越高
Mode： 选择滤波器类型
Freq： 调节滤波器中心频率

Alg.Name: Envelope
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a highly customable envelope filter. Fine tune the knobs onboard to make your creations: Funky wah, synth-y vibe, robot talk, cyber voice sweep – You decide! 

Controls: 

Sweep: Selects filter sweeping direction
Sense: Controls the sensitivity
Spread: Controls the filter stereo separation
Mode: Controls the filter mode
Range: Controls the filter frequency range
Freq: Controls the filter frequency range midpoint 
Q: Controls the filter Q
Dry Level: Controls the dry signal amount
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
Envelope 是一个包络滤波器 （Envelope Filter） 效果，适用于多种场合。它有着丰富的调节参数，可以为您带来合成器般富有科技感的音色变化。

参数控制： 

Sweep： 选择滤波器工作方式： 向上或向下扫频
Sense： 调节灵敏度，参数值越高灵敏度越高
Spread： 调节立体声声场扩散宽度
Mode： 选择滤波器类型
Range： 调节滤波器频率变化范围
Freq： 调节滤波器频率变化范围中点位置
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Dry Level：  控制干音音量
Alg.desInforCN: 能带来合成器般富有科技感的音色变化的包络滤波器效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a highly customable envelope filter.

Alg.Name: Crier G
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Crier G is a controllable band pass filter which delivers a variety of auto-wah effects. Designed for guitars, this model has many parameters for shaping the tone of your wah sound. Start with the frequency range adjustment to decide the basic flavor of your wah-wah. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Wave Shape: Selects the LFO modulation waveform applied to the filter
Rate: Controls the effect speed
Range: Controls the filter frequency range
Level: Controls the output level
Q: Controls the sharpness of the filter
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
Crier G 是一个具有丰富调节参数的自动哇音 （Auto Wah） 效果，为吉他设计，可以为您带来规律变化的哇音音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Wave Shape：  选择低频振荡器调制波形，该参数影响滤波器的音色变化规律
Rate： 控制效果速度
Range： 调节哇音滤波器中心频率
Q： 调节哇音滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 具有丰富调节参数的吉他自动哇音（Auto Wah）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A controllable band pass filter for a variety of auto-wah effects designed for guitars.

Alg.Name: LFO Filter
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.  

This is a highly customable LFO-based auto filter. Fine tune the knobs onboard to make your creations.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls: 

Wave Shape: Selects the LFO modulation waveform applied to the filter
Phase: Controls the LFO modulation L/R phase offset
Rate: Controls the LFO speed (effect speed)
Mode: Controls the filter mode
Range: Controls the filter frequency range
Freq: Controls the filter frequency range midpoint
Q: Controls the filter Q
Dry Level: Controls the dry signal amount
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

LFO Filter 是一个由低频振荡器 （LFO） 调制的、可以自动变化的滤波器，适用于多种场合。它有着丰富的调节参数，可以为您带来合成器般富有科技感的音色变化。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Wave Shape：  选择低频振荡器调制波形，该参数影响滤波器的音色变化规律
Phase： 控制低频振荡器调制波形左右声道相位偏置度，适当调节该参数可以为声音带来立体感
Rate： 控制效果速度
Mode： 选择滤波器类型是低通 （LP）、高通 （HP） 还是带通 （Band Pass）
Range： 调节滤波器频率变化范围
Freq： 调节滤波器频率变化范围中点位置
Q： 调节滤波器Q值
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Dry Level： 控制干音音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于低频振荡器（LFO）的滤波器，带来合成器般的音色变化。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a highly customable LFO-based auto filter.

Alg.Name: Vocal Filter
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This is a highly customable special auto filter providing a human-like tone with two voices. Fine tune the knobs onboard to make your creations.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls: 

Wave Shape: Selects the LFO modulation waveform applied to the filter
Vowel 1/2: Selects the filter type (vowel)  
Phase: Controls the LFO modulation L/R phase offset
Depth: Controls the effect depth
Rate: Controls the LFO speed (effect speed)
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Vocal Filter 是一个由低频振荡器（LFO）调制的、可以自动变化的滤波器，与其他滤波器不同的是，这个滤波器有两个“人声”类型可选，可以带来语音般的音色变化，为您的效果增添不一样的科技感和未来感。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Wave Shape：  选择低频振荡器调制波形，该参数影响滤波器的音色变化规律
Phase： 控制低频振荡器调制波形左右声道相位偏置度，适当调节该参数可以为声音带来立体感
Rate： 控制效果速度
Vowel 1/2：  选择人声元音类型（滤波器类型）
Depth： 调节滤波器深度
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于低频振荡器（LFO）的滤波器，带来语音般的音色变化。
Alg.desInforEN: A highly customable special auto filter providing a human-like tone.

Alg.Name: Path Filter 4
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a 4-step filter machine for creating synth-like sounds. Each step features an individual frequency control, and a rate control sets the sequencing speed. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Step 1-4: Controls the filter center frequency of each step
Rate: Controls the sequencing speed 
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
Path Filter 4 是一个带有四个步进 （Step） 的滤波器，您可以用它创造合成器风格的音色。每一个步进都有单独的滤波器中心频率控制，速度参数控制步进变化的速度。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Step 1-4：  调节每一个步进的滤波器中心频率
Rate： 调节步进变化速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 带有四个步进（Step）的滤波器。
Alg.desInforEN: A 4-step filter machine for creating synth-like sounds.

Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a 8-step filter machine for creating synth-like sounds. Each step features an individual frequency control, and a rate control sets the sequencing speed.

Step 1-8: Controls the filter center frequency of each step
Rate: Controls the sequencing speed 
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:

您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Step 1-8：  调节每一个步进的滤波器中心频率

Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 带有八个步进（Step）的滤波器。
Alg.desInforEN: A 8-step filter machine for creating synth-like sounds.

Alg.Name: Pattern Filter
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a pattern filter machine for creating synth-like sounds. It provides max. 8 steps and 8 different patterns. A rate control sets the sequencing speed. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Step: Selects the numbers of steps
Patten: Selects from 8 different sequencing patterns
Rate: Controls the sequencing speed 
Shape: Controls the filter width
Reso: Controls the filter resonance
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
Pattern Filter 是一个可选步进 （Step） 个数和步进变化样式 （Pattern） 的滤波器，您可以用它创造合成器风格的音色。该效果最多支持8个步进，有8种不同的步进变化样式可选。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Step： 选择步进个数
Pattern： 在8种步进变化样式中选择一种
Rate： 调节步进变化速度
Shape： 调节滤波器波形形状
Reso： 调节滤波器共振峰高度
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 一个可选步进（Step）个数和步进变化样式（Pattern）的滤波器。
Alg.desInforEN: A pattern filter machine for creating synth-like sounds.

Alg.Name: Analog Octa 1
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a monophonic octaver that creates notes one octave lower and two octaves lower. Single note processing and individual wet/dry signal control recreate the vintage "dirty" analog octave pedal sounds.

Controls:

Oct 1: Controls the volume of lower octave (1 oct down)
Oct 2: Controls the volume of the much lower octave (2 oct down)
Dry: Controls the dry signal level
Alg.descriptionCN:
Analog Octa 1 是一个单音式八度音效果，重现了基于模拟器件设计的复古八度效果器温暖厚实带点“脏”的独特音色。
1、2代表不同的音色类型。

参数控制： 

Oct 1：  调节低一个八度效果音的音量
Oct 2：  调节低两个八度效果音的音量
Dry： 调节干信号的音量
Alg.desInforCN: 单音式八度音效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A monophonic octaver that creates notes one octave lower and two octaves lower.

Alg.descriptionEN:

Alg.Name: Digital Octa
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is a polyphonic octaver that creates notes one octave higher and one octave lower. Individual octave voice control and dry signal control can bring you lots of fun, and polyphonic processing support means playing chords is absolutely no problem.

Controls: 

Hi Level: Controls the volume of higher octave (1 oct up)
Low Level: Controls the volume of lower octave (1 oct down)
Hi/Lo Pan: Controls the higher/lower octave signal L/R panning
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Output: Controls the overall output
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。
Digital Octa 是一个复音式八度音效果，它可以制造一个比原始信号高一个八度或低一个八度的效果音。它有着丰富的参数，您可以对效果最终呈现的音色进行详细调节。

参数控制： 

Hi Level：  调节高八度效果音的音量
Hi Pan：  调节高八度效果音左右声相
Lo Level：  调节低八度效果音的音量
Lo Pan：  调节低八度效果音左右声相
Tone： 调节效果音色明亮度
Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Output： 控制效果输出总音量
Alg.desInforCN: 复音式八度音效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A polyphonic octaver that creates notes one octave higher and one octave lower.

Alg.Name: Dual Pitch
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is a polyphonic 2-voice pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range. Detailed pitch shifting settings can bring you lots of fun. 

Controls: 

Pitch 1/2: Controls the voice 1/2 pitch shifting range by ±24 semitones 
Detune 1/2: Fine tunes the pitch correction by ±50 cents
Delay 1/2: Controls the time between dry and wet signals
Pan 1/2: Controls the wet signal L/R panning
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Mix: Controls the overall dry/wet signal ratio
Level 1/2: Controls the effect output
Output: Controls the overall output
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Dual Pitch 是一个复音移调效果，它可以叠加两个移调效果音，每个效果音可以提供最大低/高两个八度的移调范围。该效果有着丰富的参数，您可以对效果最终呈现的音色进行详细调节。

参数控制： 

Pitch 1/2：  以半音为单位调节两个移调效果音的音高
Detune 1/2：  以音分为单位调节两个移调效果音的音高偏移量，仔细调节可以做出轻度失谐的效果
Delay 1/2：  调节两个移调效果音在干声之后延迟多久发声
Pan 1/2：  调节两个移调效果音的左右声相
Level 1/2：  控制两个移调效果音的音量
Tone： 调节效果音色明亮度
Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Output： 控制效果输出总音量
Alg.desInforCN: 复音移调效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A polyphonic 2-voice pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range.

Alg.Name: Quad Pitch
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is a polyphonic 4-voice pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range. Detailed pitch shifting settings can bring you lots of fun.

Alg.Name: Classic PS
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a monophonic pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range, simulating the classic Whammy®* tone.  
Assign the Position parameter to your expression pedal, turn the expression pedal on, and you can bend the pitch by moving the pedal back and forth. 

Controls: 

Range: Selecs the pitch shifting range
Position: Controls the pedal position (min=0, max=100)
Mix: Controls the dry/wet signal ratio
Level: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个单音移调/弯音 （Pitch Bend） 效果，模拟 Whammy®* 风格的移调音色。它可以提供最大低/高两个八度的移调范围。
您可以将该效果的 Position 参数分配到表情踏板上，接入或打开表情踏板，然后移动表情踏板您就可以感受到音色变化。

参数控制： 

Range：  选择踏板在最大位置时的移调音高
Position： 用于模拟踏板位置变化
Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Level： 控制效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 单音移调/弯音（Pitch Bend）效果模拟 Whammy®* 风格的移调音色。
Alg.desInforEN: A monophonic pitch shifter simulating the classic Whammy®* tone.

Alg.Name: Pitch Shift
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a polyphonic pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range. Individual mix/max pitch range settings can bring you lots of fun. 
Assign the Position parameter to your expression pedal, turn the expression pedal on, and you can bend the pitch by moving the pedal back and forth. 

Controls: 

Min/Max Pitch: Controls the low/high pitch shifting range by ±24 semitones 
Position: Controls the pedal position (min=0, max=100)
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Level: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:

您可以将该效果 的 Position 参数分配到表情踏板上，接入或打开表情踏板，然后移动表情踏板您就可以感受到音色变化。

Level： 控制效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 复音移调/弯音（Pitch Bend）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A polyphonic pitch shifter with max. 2 octaves pitch shifting range.

Alg.Name: Detune
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This is a detune model which combines a slightly pitch shifted signal with the original signal, producing a lush, chorus-like sound. Use the Dry, Wet and Detune knobs to expand your sonic dimensions.

Controls:

Dry/Wet: Controls the dry/wet signal level
Detune: Controls the detune amount by ±50 cents
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个失谐效果，它将轻微移调的信号与原信号相结合，带来一种类似合唱又不同于合唱的独特音色。

参数控制： 

Wet/Dry： 控制效果音/原声音量大小
Detune： 以音分为单位调节失谐程度
Alg.desInforCN: 一个失谐效果，使轻微移调的信号与原信号相结合。
Alg.desInforEN: A detune model producing a lush, chorus-like sound.

Alg.Name: Dual Detune
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.

请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个失谐效果，它可以将两个轻微移调的信号与原信号相结合，带来一种类似合唱又不同于合唱的独特音色。该效果有着丰富的参数，您可以对效果最终呈现的音色进行详细调节。

参数控制： 
Detune 1/2：  以音分为单位调节两个失谐效果音的失谐程度
Delay 1/2：  调节两个失谐效果音在干声之后延迟多久发声
Pan 1/2：  调节两个失谐效果音的左右声相

Output： 控制效果输出总音量

Alg.desInforEN: A dual-voice detune effect producing a lush, chorus-like sound

Alg.Name: 80s Detune
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a detune effect simulates the detune effect coming from THAT legendary 1980s red pitch bend pedal. Great for producing 1980s tone.  

Controls:

Mode: Selects from two detuning modes
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个失谐效果，它捕捉了1980年代流行的数字效果器里的失谐音色。

参数控制： 

Mode： 控制效果模式（失谐程度）
Alg.desInforCN: 1980年代流行的数字效果器里的失谐音色。
Alg.desInforEN: Simulates the detune effect coming from THAT legendary 1980s red pitch bend pedal.

Alg.Name: String Shifter
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a polyphonic pitch shifter. You can use it as a virtual capo, or use it to simulate down tunings on your guitar.  

Controls: 

Shift: Controls the pitch shifting range by ±12 semitones 
Detune: Fine tunes the pitch correction by ±50 cents 
Volume: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个复音移调效果，您可以用它来模拟变调夹，也可以用它来模拟降弦调音。

参数控制： 

Shift： 以半音为单位调节移调音高
Detune： 以音分为单位调节移调效果音的音高偏移量，仔细调节可以做出轻度失谐的效果
Volume： 控制效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 复音移调效果，模拟变调夹或模拟降弦调音。
Alg.desInforEN: A polyphonic pitch shifter can be a virtual capo, or use it to simulate down tunings on guitar.

Alg.Name: Harmonizer 1
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a monophonic single voice automatic harmonizer with max. one octave pitch shifting range. Detailed Key, Scale and Interval settings can bring you lots of fun. 

Controls: 

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio of the effect
Key: Selects the chord key according to your music
Mode: Selects the scale mode according to your music
Interval: Selects the interval between wet and dry signal
Smooth Mode: Switch on to get a smooth note transition
Alg.descriptionCN:

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Key： 选择自动和声效果音的调号

Alg.Name: Harmonizer 2

Key: Selects the chord key according to your music
Mode: Selects the scale mode according to your music
Interval 1/2: Selects the interval between wet and dry signal
Smooth Mode: Switch on to get a smooth note transition
Alg.descriptionCN:

Alg.descriptionEN:

Output: Controls the effect output

Output： 控制效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 模拟12弦吉他音色。

Alg.Name: Bit Krusher
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a sweet-sounding bitcrusher/sample rate reducer with full control over the bit resolution and sample rate. Use the low pass filter and high pass filter onboard to get your own sound variations.

Controls: 

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio of the effect
Krush: Controls the sample rate of the effect
Bit: Controls the bit resolution of the effect
Hi Cut: Controls the cutoff frequency of the high cut filter
Lo Cut: Controls the cutoff frequency of the low cut filter
Alg.descriptionCN:
Bit Krusher 是一个是一个降采样效果，您可以通过调节旋钮获得声音独特、甜美、富有音乐性的降采样之声。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Krush： 调节效果的降采样频率
Bit： 调节效果的比特率
Hi Cut/Lo Cut：  控制效果高频/低频衰减程度
Alg.desInforCN: 一个降采样效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This model is a sweet-sounding bitcrusher/sample rate reducer.

Alg.Name: Ring Mod
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a ring modulator which produces interesting inharmonic frequency spectra. The Freq, Tone and Mix controls are tweak up unique bell and chime effects, and a Fine knob gives you extra control over the frequency. 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Freq: Controls the overall modulation frequency
Fine: Fine tune the modulation frequency by +/- 50Hz
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个环形调制效果，您可以用它来制造一些有趣的失谐音色（比如钟声和铃声）。除了常规的调制频率调节、信号干湿度调节以外，我们还提供了一个 Fine 旋钮对调制频率做更细致的调节。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Freq： 粗调效果调制频率
Fine： 以1Hz为单位精调调制频率
Tone： 调节效果音色明亮度
Alg.desInforCN: 一个环形调制效果，可以制造有趣的失谐音色（比如钟声和铃声）。
Alg.desInforEN: A ring modulator which produces interesting inharmonic frequency spectra.

Alg.Name: Telephone Line
Alg.descriptionEN:
This special filter makes you sound like you're playing over an old phone.  Tweak the Noise and Shake knobs to get a seriously iffy connection. 

Controls:

Noise: Controls the background noise amount
Shake: Controls the sound vibration
Alg.descriptionCN:
Telephone Line 是一个特殊的滤波器，它可以让您的声音听起来像是在老式电话里发出的一样。通过仔细调节旋钮参数您甚至可以模拟通讯过程中信号非常不稳定的声音状态。

参数控制： 

Noise： 调节背景噪音的音量
Shake： 调节声音的抖动幅度（颤音效果深度）
Alg.desInforCN: 可以让声音听起来像是在老式电话里发出的一样。
Alg.desInforEN: This special filter makes you sound like you're playing over an old phone.

Alg.Name: Satisfaction
Alg.descriptionEN:
Can't get no satisfaction! This model is a tape saturation simulator that simulates the sound character of a vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder, bringing you unbeatable analog warmth and natural distortion. 

Controls:

Saturation: Controls the effect gain
Mix: Controls the effect wet/dry signal ratio
Output: Controls the effect output volume
High Cut: Cuts the effect high frequency signal
Alg.descriptionCN:
Satisfaction 是一个磁带饱和度模拟器，它模拟古董盘式磁带录音机的声音特征，可以使您的音色更加温暖、富有模拟风味；您甚至可以把它当失真单块来用。

参数控制： 

Output： 调节效果输出音量
Saturation： 调节效果饱和度（增益量）
Mix： 调节干湿信号比
High Cut：  调节高频信号衰减量
Alg.desInforCN: 模拟古董盘式磁带录音机的声音特征。
Alg.desInforEN: Simulates the sound character of a vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder.

Alg.Name: Mic Lab
Alg.descriptionEN:
This filter is a vintage microphone simulator that makes you sound like you're rocking through a pre-war microphone. Use the Mic Type knob to pick the sound you like best. 

Controls:

Mic Type: Selects from three different sound characters
Gain: Controls the output level
Alg.descriptionCN:
Mic Lab 是一款老式麦克风模拟器，让您的音色听起来就像是用这些老式麦克风录制的一样。

参数控制： 

Mic Type：  选择三种麦克风类型
Gain： 调节效果增益/输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 老式麦克风录音音色模拟器。
Alg.desInforEN: Makes you sound like you're rocking through a pre-war microphone.

Alg.Name: Pitch Correction
Alg.descriptionEN:
Pitch Correction is a simple and easy-to-use automatic vocal pitch correction effect. If your voice frequency is between ±50 cents of any note in the 12-equal temperament (A=440Hz), this effect can automatically bring your voice closer to the standard frequency of that note.

Controls:

Correction: Controls the amplitude of pitch correction
Alg.descriptionCN:
Pitch Correction是一个简单好用的人声自动音高修正效果，如果您的声音频率在十二平均律（A=440Hz）任意一个音的±50音分之间，该效果可以使您的声音自动靠近那一个音的标准频率。

参数控制： 

Correction：  调节音高修正程度的大小
Alg.desInforCN: 人声自动音高修正效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Automatic vocal pitch correction effect.

Alg.Name: AT-Tune
Alg.descriptionEN:
AT-Tune is a powerful automatic pitch correction/shift effect for vocals, with a wide adjustment range. It can be used not only to adjust and correct the pitch of vocals, but also to create a robotic-like sound sound through deliberate exaggerated pitch correction and large pitch shifts.

Controls:

Humanize: Controls the naturalness of the pitch correction effect
Shift: Controls the voice 1/2 pitch shifting range by ±12 semitones
Key: Selects the target key according to your music. If you select None, the pitch will be automatically corrected to the standard frequency of the nearest note, and the Scale option will have no effect.
Scale: Selects the target scale mode according to your music
Alg.descriptionCN:
AT-Tune是一款强大的人声自动音高修正/移调效果，有着极大的调节空间，不仅可用于调整和修正人声演唱的音高，还可以通过故意夸张的音高修正、大音程的移调，创造出机械感的声音。

参数控制： 

Humanize：  调节音高修正效果的自然程度
Shift：  以半音为单位调节移调效果音的音高

Key：  选择音高修正效果的目标调号，若选择None，则音高将自动修正到相近的音的标准频率，调式选项将无效

Scale：  选择音高修正效果的目标调式
Alg.desInforCN: 人声自动音高修正/移调效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Automatic vocal pitch correction/shift effect.

Alg.Name: Vocal Harmony
Alg.descriptionEN:

Vocal Harmony is a monophonic dual voice automatic harmonizer for vocals. It automatically matches suitable harmonies to the notes you sing based on your settings. Detailed Key, Interval and Low/High settings can bring you lots of fun.

Key: Selects the key according to your music
Interval 1/2: Selects the interval between wet and dry signal
Level 1/2: Controls the effect output
Pan 1/2: Controls the wet signal L/R panning
Low/High 1/2: 2-band EQ that controls the wet signal tone
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道输入、立体声输出的效果。

Vocal Harmony是一款专为人声演唱而设计的单音移调/自动和声效果，可以叠加两个和声效果音，根据您演唱的音符自动根据您的设置配上合适的和声。该效果有着丰富的参数，您可以对效果最终呈现的音色进行详细调节。

参数控制： 

Master： 调节效果音的总输出音量
Key： 选择自动和声效果音的调号
Interval 1/2： 调节两个和声效果音相对于演唱音符的音程
Level 1/2： 控制两个和声效果音的音量
Pan 1/2： 调节两个和声效果音的左右声相
Low/High 1/2： 控制两个和声效果音的高/低频
Alg.desInforCN: 人声单音移调/自动和声效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Automatic vocal pitch correction/shift effect.

Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on the legendary Ibanez® TS-808 Tube Screamer®*. Featuring a warm, juicy overdriven sound, this Green Drive is the incomparable vintage overdrive model you've always been hoping to find.

Alg.Name: Yellow Drive
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on pretty much the first overdrive pedal the world ever saw, Yellow Drive brings you the iconic beefy, cream-like overdriven sound with pronounced details and a wide dynamic response range. NO TONE CONTROL – YOU WON'T NEED IT!

Controls: 

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Volume: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个过载效果，声音基于传奇的日产两钮黄色过载单块 - 世界上最早出现的过载单块之一，非对称削波电路设计赋予了它奶油一般的丰富音色。

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 基于传奇的日产两钮黄色过载单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Inspired by the evergreen TS-style overdrive served with its most enduring modification.

Alg.Name: Swarm Drive
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the Providence® SOV-2 Stampede OD* pedal, this model delivers the natural overdrive tone without affecting the inherent sound character of your guitar. No matter what you need – from crunchy rhythms to singing solos, the Swarm Drive will never let you down.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.

Swarm Drive的声音基于 Providence® SOV-2 Stampede OD* 过载效果器 - 众多“无染色过载 （Transparent Overdrive）” 效果器之一，它可以忠实反馈乐器本身的声音特性。

Alg.desInforEN: Based on the widely used blues overdrive (and the famous PHAT-modified version).

Alg.Name: Super Drive
Alg.descriptionEN:
This Super Drive is based on a classic, widely used overdrive which features a unique asymmetric overdrive circuitry. Delivering a rich, authentic-sounding tube-driven overdrive effect with wide tonal range, it's one of a must-have overdrive model in your effect chain.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

这是一个过载效果，声音基于过载界另一经典设计：“超级过载”三钮黄色过载单块（日产版本）。它独特的非对称削波电路设计为您呈现自然、温暖、粘稠的音色。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度

Alg.Name: Screamood
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Screamood model is a classic overdrive inspired by the evergreen TS-style overdrive served with its most enduring modification. Use the two onboard switches to find your favorite screaming mood.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Fat: Switches extra resonance on/off 
Air: Switches extra presence on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
Screamood是一个过载效果，它的音色基于“常青树”TS系列经典过载。我们在TS音色基础上做了改进，增加了几个参数，带来更大的调节范围和可玩性。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Fat： 用于增加额外低频
Air： 用于增加额外临场度
Alg.desInforCN: 基于“常青树”TS系列经典过载，在此基础上做了改进。
Alg.desInforEN: Inspired by the evergreen TS-style overdrive served with its most enduring modification.

Alg.Name: Dr. Blues
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the widely used blues overdrive (and the famous PHAT-modified version), Dr. Blues is a roadmap of classic bluesy textures to take you from sweet Tennessee to screaming Texas. Turn up the GAIN knob to get a warm distortion with tons of sensitivity and a wide frequency response. 
It works great on bass too!

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
Dr. Blues是一个基于著名“Blues过载”单块建模的过载效果。声如其名，它无疑是演奏 Blues 风格的不二之选。它不会像TS风格过载单块一样衰减低频，因此它也同样适用于贝斯手。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益

Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the legendary Fulltone® OCD®* overdrive pedal, this model gives you that great amp-like flavor of a cranked up vintage amp. Get wild with this responsive, super powerful overdrive monster! 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Mode: Selects from two different sound characters: HP (High Peak mode with more bottom end and distortion), LP (Low Peak mode without changing your original tone)

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款过载效果基于 Fulltone® OCD®* 过载效果器，众多单块玩家的首选过载之一；它呈现出的狂野有力的过载音色令人难以忘怀。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果音量
Mode： 选择工作模式： 
-LP（Low Peak）： 呈现出自然平滑的音色响应
-HP（High Peak）： 呈现出激烈凶猛的音色响应，并且有着更多的增益度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。

Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fulltone® OCD®* overdrive pedal.

Alg.descriptionEN:
The Tube Clipper is based on the legendary B. K. Butler® Tube Driver®*, the REAL TUBE overdrive with a 12AX7 tube inside. Famous for the violin-like "Cliffs of Dover" tone, it sits atop many a studio pro and live musician's wish list.

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Volume: Controls the effect output
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Tube Clipper 的音色基于 B. K. Butler® Tube Driver®* 传奇电子管过载单块： 它内置一根12AX7电子管，由于 Eric Johnson、 David Gilmour 等大师的使用而名声大噪。它细腻柔和的音色自推出之日起备受众多大牌乐手和单块发烧友推崇。

Alg.descriptionEN:
This Blues Butter overdrive model recreates the magic of the classic Bluesbreaker®* sound for you. Based on the Marshall® Bluesbreaker®* overdrive pedal, this low-mid-gain overdrive will add sweetness (and a little wildness) to your guitar sound. You can use it as a clean boost too!

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

Blues Butter 是一个过载效果，其音色基于 Marshall® Bluesbreaker* 过载效果器。这款效果器原本是用来模拟同名音箱的声音，后来很多著名乐手（如 John Mayer） 挖掘出了它的潜力。这个单块的电路设计也为很多发烧单块提供了灵感。

Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Marshall® Bluesbreaker®* overdrive pedal.

Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the legendary Marshall® Drive Master* overdrive pedal, the Grand Driver model offers a 3-band tone control. It is like adding an extra amp with classic British overdrive tone to your set up. This will push your performance to an even higher level!

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

Grand Driver 的音色基于Marshall® Drive Master* 单块，有些人描述它的音色用了一个比较贴切的短语： “JCM800* in a box” 。它同样有很多英伦/另类乐手使用，只是知名度没有Marshall®*另外两款失真那么高。

Alg.desInforCN: 基于Marshall® Drive Master* 单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Marshall® Drive Master* overdrive pedal.

Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a touch-sensitive overdrive with wide-ranged dynamics. Based on the legendary Hermida® Zendrive®*, the Zen Garden delivers an overdriven tone associated with some of the finest, most costly amplifiers on the market. With the four knobs onboard, you can easily touch the soul of ZEN！
