*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Faun Drive 是一个过载效果，基于 Klon® Centaur* 过载效果器，也就是在发烧友当中广为人知的“人马过载”。它的音色应该不需要过多介绍了： 过载界的试金石，用过的人都说好。
另外，将 Gain 拧到最小，这个效果和原版一样可以当 Clean Boost 使用。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Klon® Centaur* 过载效果器，“人马过载”。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Klon® Centaur*.

Alg.Name: Amore Eterno
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on the famous Lovepedal® Eternity* overdrive pedal, a Screamer-inspired overdrive that goes beyond the green machine. Same as original, the unique Glass control makes it work great as both overdrive and clean boost. Jump in to that eternal sound beloved by Police's Andy Summers and GNR's Richard Fortus.  

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Amore Eterno 是一个过载效果，声音基于 Lovepedal® Eternity* 过载效果器。它的声音在TS风格上更进一步，声音更加开放，同时也有着更广的音色调节范围。著名使用者有 The Police 的 Andy Summers 和 Guns ‘n’ Roses 的 Richard Fortus。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Lovepedal® Eternity* 过载效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Lovepedal® Eternity* overdrive pedal.

Alg.Name: Precise Attack
Alg.descriptionEN:
Precise Attack is a modern booster/overdrive model based on the famous Horizon Devices® Precision Drive*. Designed by Misha Mansoor, this pedal is an everything solution for progressive musicians.
Plug in an extended range guitar, or run into a high gain amp to find the prog magic. Special designed Attack control tightens the low ends and makes your sound prog-y. A built-in smart noise gate reduces hum and keeps your palm muting tight.  

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Attack: 6-mode selector; dial clockwise for a tighter, more aggressive sound 
Gate: Controls the built-in noise gate threshold

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Precise Attack 是一个激励/过载效果，其音色基于 Horizon Devices® Precision Drive* 单块；它由 Misha Mansoor 参与设计，是现代派吉他手的万用武器。当您将它搭配6/7/8弦现代派吉他、再搭配一个高增益音箱使用的时候，您会感觉音色瞬间前卫了起来。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Attack： 调节声音特性，数值越大音色越有侵略性
Gate： 调节内置噪音门阈值

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Horizon Devices® Precision Drive* 单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Horizon Devices® Precision Drive*.

Alg.Name: Magic T
Alg.descriptionEN:
Magic T is an overdrive model based on the legendary Paul Cochrane Timmy®* overdrive (V2) pedal – one of the first transparent overdrive pedals. Like the original, Magic T pushes your amp/guitar to the limit while maintaining the original flavor and dynamics. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Volume: Controls the effect output
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone (counterclockwise, same as original) 
Mode: Selects from three clipping modes:
-I: asymmetrical clipping  
-II: symmetrical clipping  
-III: symmetrical clipping with more compression feel 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Magic T 是一个过载效果，声音基于 Paul Cochrane® Timmy® V2* 过载效果器，市面上“无音染过载” （Transparent Overdrive） 单块流派的开山祖师。它能够忠实反映出您所使用设备的音色特点，并且手感也是一流水平。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段衰减式均衡，用于衰减效果的低频/高频（和V2版原版一致）
Mode： 选择过载削波方式/音色特征：
-I： 非对称削波
-II： 对称削波
-III： 对称削波并带有更多压缩感

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Paul Cochrane® Timmy® V2* 过载效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Paul Cochrane Timmy®* overdrive (V2) pedal.

Alg.Name: Prince of Drive
Alg.descriptionEN:
Prince of Drive is based on the famous Analog.Man™ Prince of Tone* overdrive pedal, one of the best transparent overdrive pedals. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Tone: Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Mode: Select from 3 different modes
HF Trim: Controls the effect presence

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Prince of Drive 的音色基于著名的 Analog.Man™ Prince of Tone* 过载效果器，“透明过载”类型的佼佼者。

参数控制：

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Mode：选择模式：
-Clean： 干净清澈的过载音色，可用于激励
-OD： 温暖且不失清晰的过载音色
-Dist： 过载度更高的音色
HF Trim： 调节音色临场度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Analog.Man™ Prince of Tone* 过载效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Analog.Man™ Prince of Tone* overdrive pedal.

Alg.Name: Noble Drive
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on Nobels® ODR-1 Natrual Overdrive*, a must-have among countless session musicians like Tom Bukovac, Jerry Donahue, John Shanks, and more. 

Controls:

Drive: Controls the gain amount
Spectrum: Boosts/cuts both bass and treble frequency
Level: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Noble Drive的音色基于著名的Nobels® ODR-1 Natural Overdrive*过载单块，有着中性、自然的过载音色，备受众多录音室/现场乐手喜爱。著名使用者包括Tom Bukovac、Jerry Donahue、John Shanks等。

参数控制： 

Drive： 调节效果增益
Spectrum：同时提升/衰减低频和高频
Level： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的Nobels® ODR-1 Natural Overdrive*过载单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Nobels® ODR-1 Natrual Overdrive*

Alg.Name: Big Pie
Alg.descriptionEN:
Many dirt pedals released throughout the 1970s began to blur the lines between fuzz and distortion. The Big Pie is one of them. Based on the legendary Big Muff Pi®*, this model is a fresh take on the fuzz tone territory. You get a wide-ranged sound character using the TONE knob – from creamy overdrive-like sound to really aggressive fuzzy tone.

Controls:

Sustain: Controls the gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Big Pie 是一个法兹效果，基于 Electro-Harmonix® Big Muff Pi®* 经典单块建模而来。它的音色模糊了法兹和失真的界限，独树一帜，很多人直接将其归类为 “Muff” 类音色。它的 Tone 旋钮更像是一个声音特性调节，有着超大的音色变化范围。

参数控制： 

Sustain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Electro-Harmonix® Big Muff Pi®* 经典单块建模。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Big Muff Pi®*.

Alg.Name: Face Fuzz
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on the legendary Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*. Featuring a unique, unmistakable creamy sound with incredible dynamics, the pedal remains a favorite among many rock stars – Hendrix, Gilmour, Townshend and more! 

Controls:

Fuzz: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Face Fuzz 的音色基于法兹单块界的传奇：  Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*， 为您呈现平滑、厚重的经典锗管法兹之声。作为一个众多大师使用过的法兹单块，它的音色无需过多描述。

参数控制： 

Fuzz： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于法兹单块界的传奇：Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*.

Alg.Name: Bend Fuzz
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on the legendary Sola Sound® Tone Bender Mk II®* fuzz pedal – the legend of the legends. We reproduced the smooth, honey-like tone that was beloved by Page and many more professional musicians. 

Controls:

Fuzz: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Bend Fuzz 的音色基于法兹单块界的另一个传奇： Sola Sound® Tone Bender® Mk II*， 它蜜糖一般的锗管法兹之声也是上到各路英雄豪杰、下到普通玩家的最爱。

参数控制： 

Fuzz： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于法兹单块界的另一个传奇： Sola Sound® Tone Bender® Mk II*。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Sola Sound® Tone Bender Mk II®* fuzz pedal.

Alg.Name: Face Fuzz Ge
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model recreates the sound of a Dunlop® Fuzz Face®* (with Germanium transistors) with advanced modeling methods. 

Controls:

Fuzz: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Face Fuzz Ge使用了更先进的建模方法，重现了一块Dunlop® Fuzz Face®*（锗管版本）的音色。

参数控制： 

Fuzz： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于经典的Dunlop® Fuzz Face®*（锗管版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: This model recreates the sound of a Dunlop® Fuzz Face®* (with Germanium transistors).

Alg.Name: Plustortion
Alg.descriptionEN:
This little yellow box has produced lots of great soundings in countless classic studio albums. Yeah, we're talking the legendary MXR® M104 Distortion +*, and this M104-based Plustortion. The Plustortion recreated the Germanium-powered soft clipping distortion, like what Randy Rhoads and other hard rockers do! 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Plustortion 的音色基于 MXR® M104 Distortion +*  经典失真单块（早期版本），它忠实还原了 Randy Rhoads 等众多摇滚乐手推崇的经典锗管失真音色。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 MXR® M104 Distortion +*  经典失真单块（早期版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary MXR® M104 Distortion +*.

Alg.Name: Smooth Dist
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the famous late-70's distortion pedal that is a favorite among pro guitarists and pedal modifiers, the Smooth Dist is truly a classic distortion model. It produces a distortion sound ranging from screaming loud to whisper soft. Of course, it faithfully reproduces the dynamics of your playing style. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
Smooth Dist 的声音基于70年代末期发售的著名橘色失真单块（日产版本，它的早期日产版本和第三方改装版本在市面上依然备受好评），有着宽广的音色可调范围和不俗的动态。 

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 基于70年代末期发售的著名橘色失真单块（日产版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous late-70's distortion pedal.

Alg.Name: Black Tail
Alg.descriptionEN:
Here is another dirt pedal that changed the rules.
Based on the ProCo™ RAT2* distortion pedal (early LM308 op-amp version), Black Tail brings you the real underground rock scene. Sweet overdrives, grinding rhythms, roaring solos – Black Tail cashes in with authority and power.
Same as the original, Black Tail features the legendary FILTER control: Turn it clockwise to cut off the high end, turn it counterclockwise to allow the natural brightness of your instrument through.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Filter: Counterclockwise controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Black Tail 是一个基于 ProCo™ The Rat* （LM308 版本）的失真效果，有着细腻的高频、厚重结实而略带粘稠感的低频。同时，它的演奏手感好、可调范围大，当过载、当法兹用或者拿来刷音墙都不错。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Filter： 调节音色明亮度（反向调节，与原版一致）
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 ProCo™ The Rat* （LM308 版本）的失真效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the ProCo™ RAT2* distortion pedal (early LM308 op-amp version).

Alg.Name: Governor
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the legendary Marshall® The Guv'Nor* distortion pedal which was well known for its high quality and iconic British distortion tones, it recreated the world-famous drive sound of a classic Marshall® stack at full tilt.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Governor的音色基于 Marshall® Guv’Nor®* 失真效果器，为您带来经典不将就的英式失真音色。它不光适合用于常规演奏，也适合像一个典型英伦乐手一样拿来刷音墙。Radiohead的 Ed O’Brian 是著名使用者之一。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果低/中/高频

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Marshall® Guv’Nor®* 失真效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Marshall® The Guv'Nor* distortion pedal.

Alg.Name: Shredder
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Shredder is based on the legendary Marshall® Shred Master* distortion pedal, the one well known for used by Radiohead's Jonny Greenwood to create his twisted distortion walls.  

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Contour/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Shredder 的音色基于 Marshall® Shred Master®* 失真单块，您可以在很多80-90年代的另类摇滚乐队乐手的单块板上见到它。著名使用者有 Radiohead 的 Jonny Greenwood、 Thom Yorke 等。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果音量
Bass/Contour/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果低/中/高频

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Marshall® Shred Master®* 失真单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Marshall® Shred Master* distortion pedal.

Alg.Name: Crunchist
Alg.descriptionEN:
Based on the MI Audio® Crunch Box®*, this model brings you high-gain British amp distortion in a stompbox. Simple and straightforward, with just gain, tone, and volume control, the Crunchist distortion easily recreates the huge crunch of a British amp.

Controls:
Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Crunchist 是一个音色基于 MI Audio® Crunch Box®* 的英式失真效果，简便的三旋钮控制和宽广的动态范围为您的音色表现力添砖加瓦。它的音色应该无需过多阐述，市面上该效果器大大小小各种版本以及各种复刻足以说明其受认可程度。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 色基于 MI Audio® Crunch Box®* 的英式失真效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the MI Audio® Crunch Box®*.

Alg.Name: Metaland
Alg.descriptionEN:
Metaland Distortion provides an insanely heavy distortion with edgy highs, powerful mids and heavy lows. Inspired by the world's most popular heavy metal distortion pedal, the Metaland is definitely an extreme "dirt wall" creator.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Mid Freq: Controls the range of middle frequency
Alg.descriptionCN:
Metaland 是一款高增益失真效果，它的音色基于一款非常畅销的经典重金属失真效果器（没错，就是黑色机身、橙色字体的那一款）。它的音色现在听起来可能有点过时，但是依然有很多人对它爱不释手。另外，它内置的三段均衡+中频扫频调节在调音色的时候还是很好用的。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果低/中/高频
Mid Freq： 调节中频频点

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一款非常畅销的经典重金属失真效果器（黑色机身、橙色字体）。
Alg.desInforEN: Inspired by the world's most popular heavy metal distortion pedal.

Alg.Name: Rebel
Alg.descriptionEN:
Go and get your riot gear! Rebel is based on the famous Suhr® Riot Distortion™* pedal, characterized by massive distortion that maintains touch sensitivity. Now you've got an authoritative shredding and riffing machine just a kick away!

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Mode: Selects from three different sound characters:
-Natural: Neutral sound
-Modern: A tighter, more aggressive sound
-Vintage: A smoother, warmer sound

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Rebel 是一个音色基于 Suhr® Riot Distortion™* 的失真效果，一款简单好用的多用途失真，虽然它只有三个旋钮加一个音色选择开关，但是可调范围很大，无论拿来刷 Riff 还是弹 Solo 都很合适。

参数控制： 
Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Mode： 选择三种不同的音色特性：
-Natural： 比较中性的音色
-Modern： 更富侵略性的音色
-Vintage： 更复古的音色

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Suhr® Riot Distortion™* 的失真效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Suhr® Riot Distortion™* pedal.

Alg.Name: Pleximaker
Alg.descriptionEN:
Here's another great 80s lead sound: Based on the famous Wampler® Plexitortion* pedal, this Pleximaker does exactly what you think: kick it on to get hot-rodded British lead amp tone. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Mode: Selects from two different sound characters: Vintage/Modern
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Pleximaker 的音色基于著名的 Wampler® Plexitortion* 失真单块，带给您热辣的80年代风格英式失真音色。而且就像很多 Wampler®* 失真单块一样，它有着相当不错的可调范围。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Mode： 选择两种不同的音色特性：
-Vintage： 复古风格音色
-Modern： 现代风格音色
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果低/中/高频

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Wampler® Plexitortion* 失真单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Wampler® Plexitortion* pedal.

Alg.Name: Panama Lead
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Panama Lead is a distortion model inspired by the legendary "brown sound" amp. This distortion takes your brown lead all the way from raw to relentless. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output
Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Tight: Controls the low bottom resonance
Alg.descriptionCN:
Panama Lead 是一个失真效果，它的音色灵感来自 Van Halen 的标志音色：  “Brown Sound”。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Tight： 调节低频量或音色松紧度
Alg.desInforCN: 音色灵感来自 Van Halen 的标志音色：  “Brown Sound”。
Alg.desInforEN: A distortion model inspired by the legendary "brown sound" amp.

Alg.Name: Fryman Dist
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is based on a famous dirt box recreating the iconic boutique UK-style hi-gain "Brown Eye" tone with versatility.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Presence: Controls the effect headroom
Tight: Controls the low bottom resonance
Alg.descriptionCN:
Fryman Dist的音色基于一块著名失真单块，它重现了该单块的标志性现代英式高增益（即 “Brown Eye”）之声。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble：两段均衡调节效果低/高频
Presence：调节效果临场度
Tight： 调节低频量或音色松紧度
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一块著名失真单块，标志性现代英式高增益（即 “Brown Eye”）之声。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on a famous dirt box recreating the iconic boutique UK-style hi-gain "Brown Eye" tone.

Alg.Name: Solid Steel
Alg.descriptionEN:
Solid Steel is a flexible drive pedal designed for bass. We voiced this one to deliver a rich driven bass sound. Use the Mode knob to select from 3 unique sound characters. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
Mode: Selects from 3 different sound characters: Normal (neutral sound), Scoop (mid-scooped sound),
Edge (edgy sound)
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Alg.descriptionCN:
Solid Steel 是一个灵活多变的贝斯过载效果，带有三种音色模式。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
Mode： 选择三种不同的音色模式： 
-Normal： 原始音色模式
-Scoop： 有着更加凹陷的中频
-Edge： 有着更加锐利的高频
Alg.desInforCN: 灵活多变的贝斯过载效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Solid Steel is a flexible drive pedal designed for bass.

Alg.Name: Bass OD
Alg.descriptionEN:
If you're looking for an all-around bass driver, this is the one. Based on the widely used yellow bass driver, the Bass OD gives you a massive bass sound with super wide tonal flexibility. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Volume: Controls the effect output
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Alg.descriptionCN:
Bass OD 是为贝斯手设计的贝斯过载/失真效果，声音没有什么特殊的特点，因此适用于多种场合。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 控制效果高/低频
Alg.desInforCN: 为贝斯手设计的贝斯过载/失真效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the widely used yellow bass driver.

Alg.Name: Behemoth M
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Behemoth M is based on the famous Darkglass® Microtubes B7K Analog Bass Preamp* pedal. This pedal can turn your whispering bass into a growling monster, all while preserving the clarity. Onboard EQ gives you wide tonal flexibility. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Volume: Controls the effect output
Low/Low Mid/High Mid/Treble: 4-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Attack: Boosts/cuts high frequency amount

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Behemoth M 的音色基于著名的 Darkglass® Microtubes B7K* 贝斯前级效果器，打开它的瞬间您的音色可以瞬间咆哮怒吼起来，与此同时还有着相当不错的清晰度。另外，它多样化的参数保证了您可以很精细地调节您的音色。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
Low/Low Mid/High Mid/Treble：  四段均衡调节效果低/中低/中高/高频
Attack： 提升或衰减高频响应：
-Cut： 衰减高频响应
-Boost： 提升高频响应
-Flat： 保持原始音色状态

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Darkglass® Microtubes B7K* 贝斯前级效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Darkglass® Microtubes B7K Analog Bass Preamp* pedal.

Alg.Name: Basshammer
Alg.descriptionEN:
Basshammer is based on the famous Aguilar® Tone Hammer* Bass Preamp* pedal, a great swiss army knife for modern bassists. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Master: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Mid Freq: Controls the range of middle frequency
Drive: Turn on for extra gain stage

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Basshammer 的音色基于著名的 Aguilar® Tone Hammer* 前级效果器，带有两种音色、三段均衡+中频扫频调节，贝斯手音色利器。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Master： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果低/中/高频
Mid Freq： 调节中频频点
Drive： 额外增益开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于著名的 Aguilar® Tone Hammer* 前级效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Aguilar® Tone Hammer* Bass Preamp* pedal.

Alg.Name: Bass Grinder HQ
Alg.descriptionEN:
Hotone's next-gen effect algorithms! Leading a qualitative leap in both hearing and playing.
This bass preamp model is based on Tech 21® SansAmp® Bass Driver DI*. It boasts an exceptional dynamic range, enabling it to effortlessly produce bass tones ranging from powerful clean sounds to crushing distortions.

Controls:

Level: Controls the effect output
Blend: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Gain: Controls the gain amount
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Presence: Controls the effect headroom

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
Hotone最新一代算法，为演奏感和听感带来质的飞跃！
这款贝斯效果使用了我们最新一代的建模技术，基于Tech 21® SansAmp® Bass Driver DI*前级效果器建模，它有着绝佳的动态范围，能够轻松获得从富有冲击力的清音到粉碎机一般的失真的贝斯音色。

参数控制： 

Level： 调节效果输出音量
Blend： 调节干湿信号比
Drive： 调节效果增益
Bass/Treble： 控制效果高/低频
Presence： 调节音色临场度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 最新一代算法，基于SansAmp® Bass Driver DI*贝斯前级效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Next-gen effect algorithms based on the Mesa/Boogie® JP-2C™* amp head (CH2).

Alg.Name: Tweed Chap
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Tweed Chap is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of the legendary Fender® Tweed Champ* amp (5F1 version), an awesome little "practice amp" with huge tone. Crank it up you get the sweet "boxy" sound which made it popular in studios.  

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟的音色基于 Fender® Tweed Champ* 一体音箱（5F1版本）。它的设计初衷是作为练习音箱使用，然而人们发现这款音箱在后级过载时的音色相当甜美且富有风味，之后也就因此成为了一票乐手的最爱。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Tweed Champ* 一体音箱（5F1版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fender® Tweed Champ* amp (5F1 version).

Alg.Name: Tweed Lux
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Tweed Lux is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of the legendary Fender® Tweed Deluxe* amp (5E3 version, BRIGHT channel).  Featuring rich, singing clean and juicy, luscious overdrive, the mysterious DELUXE amp with the TWEED cover can be found everywhere from studios to bedrooms. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Output: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟的音色基于 Fender® Tweed Deluxe* 一体音箱（5E3版）的 Bright 通道。作为一个被复刻无数次的经典音箱，您可以在各大录音棚里发现它的身影，同时您也能在大量经典的唱片中找到这款传奇音箱的音色。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Tone： 调节音箱音色明亮度
Output： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Tweed Deluxe* 一体音箱（5E3版）的 Bright 通道。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fender® Tweed Deluxe* amp (5E3 version, BRIGHT channel).

Alg.Name: Tweed Prince
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Tweed Prince is an amp simulator based on one of the legendary studio combo amps: Fender® Tweed Princeton Amp* (5F2-A version), another "huge tone in a small box" masterpiece which remains popular among players, builders and collectors. A Tone knob makes it more versatile.   

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Output: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟的音色基于 Fender® Tweed Princeton* 一体音箱（5F2-A版）， Leo Fender 的早期杰作之一，也是因为能产生悦耳动听的后级过载音色而出名，诠释了什么叫做“小身材，大能量”。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Tone： 调节音箱音色明亮度
Output： 调节效果输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Tweed Princeton* 一体音箱（5F2-A版）。
Alg.desInforEN: based on the legendary Fender® Tweed Princeton Amp* (5F2-A version).

Alg.Name: Baseman Norm
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of the legendary Fender® Bassman®* amp (5F6-A version, Normal channel), the American legend with a twangy top and fat bottom end. Originally designed for bass, it soon became popular among guitar players.

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Presence: Controls the effect headroom
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款音箱模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® ‘59 Bassman®* 一体音箱（5F6-A版）的 Normal 通道。它原本是设计给贝斯使用的音箱，但是作为吉他音箱使用时，它那丰满的音色、充沛的泛音和丰富的声音细节让人爱不释手。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Presence： 调节音箱音色临场度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节音箱的低/中/高频响应

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® ‘59 Bassman®* 一体音箱（5F6-A版）的 Normal 通道。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fender® Bassman®* amp (5F6-A version, Normal channel).

Alg.Name: Black Twin
Alg.descriptionEN:
The original clean sound. 
The Black Twin is based on the legendary Fender® '65 Twin Reverb®* amp. It provides a super clean, crystal-like sound with scooped mids, popularly known as the "Blackface Sound".  

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® ‘65 Twin Reverb®* 一体音箱。它拥有纯净如水晶般的原声 （Clean） ，几乎定义了电吉他原声的音色标准。它不仅可以单独使用，也适合作为单块平台搭配单块使用。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节音箱的低/中/高频响应
Bright： 额外音色明亮度开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® ‘65 Twin Reverb®* 一体音箱。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fender® '65 Twin Reverb®* amp.

Alg.Name: Black Deluxe
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Black Deluxe is an amp simulator based on the legendary Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* amp (Normal CH), providing you a more scooped "blackface" sound with chime-y highs. Plus, it's easier to crank up too! 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* 一体音箱的 Normal 通道。相比起 ‘65 Twin Reverb®* 来说，它的中频凹陷度更加明显，高频更加通透明亮，将它的后级推至过载也更加容易。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®*  一体音箱的 Normal 通道。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* amp (Normal CH).

Alg.Name: Black Deluxe+
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Black Deluxe+ is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* amp (Vibrato CH – the most popular channel among musicians), providing you a more scooped "blackface" sound with chime-y highs. Plus, it's easier to crank up too! 

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* 一体音箱的 Vibrato 通道（乐手们更加喜爱这个通道的声音）。相比起 ‘65 Twin Reverb®* 来说，它的中频凹陷度更加明显，高频更加通透明亮，将它的后级推至过载也更加容易。

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Blackface Deluxe Reverb®* 一体音箱的 Vibrato 通道。

Alg.Name: Black Prince
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Black Prince is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Blackface Princeton®* amp (AA964 version). Push it to the verge of breakup you'll find the fantastic tone beloved by lots of musicians. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Blackface Princeton®* 一体音箱（AA964版本），和它的 Tweed 版本一样，也是“小身材，大能量”的诠释者。当它的后级发生轻微过载时，您就会感受到其音色的魅力所在。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Blackface Princeton®* 一体音箱（AA964 版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Fender® Blackface Princeton®* amp (AA964 version).

Alg.Name: Black Super
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Black Super is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Blackface Super Reverb®* amp (AB763 version), a huge sounding amp delivering you the lovely "blackface" chimes with enhanced treble and bass.  

Controls:
Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount 
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Blackface Super Reverb®* 一体音箱（AB763 版本）。它有着典型的 “Blackface” 风格音色特征，同时有着更加突出的低频和高频。原版音箱有一个公认的好音色参数叫做 “Magic 6” （将 Volume 调到6， Bass 调到2， Middle 调到3， Treble 调到6），您也可以在这上面试试看。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节音箱的低/中/高频响应
Bright： 额外音色明亮度开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Blackface Super Reverb®* 一体音箱（AB763 版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Fender® Blackface Super Reverb®* amp (AB763 version).

Alg.Name: Black Vibra
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Black Vibra is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Blackface Vibroverb®* amp (AA763 version), which contributed a lot on SRV's iconic colossal tone. Plug in a classic ST-type guitar and you'll feel your Texas blood flooding!   

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Blackface Vibroverb®* 一体音箱（AB763 版本），一款比较罕见的 Fender®* 音箱。它搭载一个15寸扬声器，是 Stevie Ray Vaughan 音色秘密的中的重要一环。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应
Bright： 额外音色明亮度开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Blackface Vibroverb®* 一体音箱（AB763 版本）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Fender® Blackface Vibroverb®* amp (AA763 version).

Alg.Name: Brown King Clean
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Brown King Clean is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Brownface Vibro-King®* amp (FAT switch off), one of Gary Clark Jr.'s favorite. It gives you a beautiful shimmering clean when turned down, and a serious touch-sensitive dirt when cranked up. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Brownface Vibro-King®* 一体音箱（FAT开关关闭）。它不是一款历史悠久的音箱（1993年才发售），但是它独特的三扬声器设计和精心设计的电路搭配得出的音色在复古和现代之间巧妙地取了一个平衡，呈现出蜜糖般的独特音色。著名使用者有 Gary Clark Jr. 、 Eric Clapton 等。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节音箱的低/中/高频响应

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Fender® Brownface Vibro-King®* 一体音箱（FAT开关关闭）。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the Fender® Brownface Vibro-King®* amp (FAT switch off).

Alg.Name: Brown Vibra
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Brown Vibra is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Brownface Vibrolux®* Amp (6G11 version), giving you a warmer, slightly dirtier Fender®* tone. It became a rock legend after Mark Knopfler used it to record the famous Sultan of the Swing album. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Brownface Vibrolux®* 一体音箱（6G11版本），为您带来有别于 “Blackface” 音色的另一种 Fender®* 风味： 声音更加温暖，也更“脏”一点。 Dire Straits 乐队的 Mark Knopfler 正是用了这一款音箱录制了他们的 《Sultans of the Swing》 专辑。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应

Alg.Name: Brown Concert
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Brown Concert is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Brownface Concert®* Amp (6G12 version, Vibrato input), one of the crown jewels of vintage amps. The sound is pure, shimmering with lots of headroom. Of course you can also push it to the edge to get a mild, brown-ish overdrive. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount 
Presence: Controls the effect headroom
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® Brownface Concert®* 一体音箱（6G12版本），一款在复古玩家当中备受推崇的音箱，有着令人惊叹的声音细节和动态范围。如果您将它的后级推至过载，那么它会呈现出粘稠细密的过载音色。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Presence： 调节音箱音色临场度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Treble： 两段均衡调节音箱的低/高频响应

The Brown Super is an amp simulator based on the Fender® Brownface Super-Amp* (6G4 version), one of the first twin-speaker "professional" amp, delivering a touch sensitive, sweet Brownface-era tone. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount

The Silver Twin is based on a 1970's Fender® Silverface Twin Reverb®* amp (AC568 circuit, Vibrato input), giving you a different sculpting of the classic "Fender®* Tone" – a crystal-like sound with scooped mids and great headroom.

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

Alg.Name: Silver Master
Alg.descriptionEN:
The Silver Master is based on the legendary Fender® Silverface Bandmaster®* amp (early AB763 version), which was treated as the "holy grail of Fender®* tone".  Not much tweaking is needed - Just plug in, turn up the volume and feel the magic.  

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount
Output: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款前级模拟效果的音色基于 Fender® SIlverface Bandmaster®* 箱头（AB763版本）。这台音箱被很多古董 Fender®* 音箱收藏家和玩家视为珍宝，因为它不需要怎么调就可以发出惊人的悦耳音色，在众多Fender®*音箱中有着顶级的音色表现。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益

Alg.Name: Superb Dual Clean
Alg.descriptionEN:
SUPERB retro tone. 
The Superb Dual Clean is based on the famous Supro® Dual-Tone 1624T* combo (CH 1). It produces the sweet 60s "stairway" scene replica, from bell-like cleans to gritty blues. 

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount 
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Output: Controls the master output

这是一个基于 Supro® Dual-Tone 1624T* 原声音色的前级模拟效果，为您带来风味十足的复古 Feel。 如果您想要 Stairway to Heaven 里的音色，不妨一试。

Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous Supro® Dual-Tone 1624T* combo (CH 1).

Alg.Name: Voxy 15 TB
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of a vintage VOX®* AC15* combo (with Top Boost), the little brother of the legendary VOX® AC30*, giving you the same British Invasion sound.

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount 
Tone cut: Counterclockwise controls the effect tone 
Master: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款音箱模拟的音色基于 VOX® AC15 Top Boost* 一体音箱，它为您带来了经典的“英伦入侵” （British Invasion） 之声。仔细调节 Tone Cut 旋钮您就可以体会到它不同于其他品牌英式音箱的独特魅力。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益

Alg.desInforCN: 基于 VOX® AC15 Top Boost* 一体音箱。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the vintage VOX®* AC15* combo (with Top Boost)

Alg.Name: Voxy 30HW Norm
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of the VOX®* AC30HW* combo (Normal channel). As the UK music scene grew out of small pubs to later cross the Pond, almost everyone was using the combo amp covered with a diamond grill cloth, the legendary VOX® AC30*. This became the British Invasion sound.

Controls:

Volume: Controls the output volume (post gain)
Tone cut: Counterclockwise controls the effect tone 
Master: Controls the effect output 
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款音箱模拟的音色基于 VOX® AC30HW* 一体音箱的 Normal 通道，它为您带来了经典的“英伦入侵”（British Invasion）之声。仔细调节 Tone Cut 旋钮您就可以体会到它不同于其他品牌英式音箱的独特魅力。

参数控制：

Alg.desInforEN: Based on the VOX®* AC30HW* combo (Normal channel).

Alg.Name: Hiway 103 Norm
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is an amp simulator based on the sound characteristics of the legendary Hiwatt® DR103* amp head (NORMAL channel), which has proved itself through decades of rock history (think Gilmour, Townshend, et al.). Set it up for pure, powerful, transparent tone or crank it to get some rich British overdrive – you decide!

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output and gain amount 
Presence: Controls the effect headroom
Master: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of the products.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个基于 Hiwatt® DR103* （Normal 通道）的音箱模拟效果，英式音箱界的另一款经典产品。它的音色在摇滚音乐史上有着举足轻重的地位，它军工级的制造品质使得它经得起大大小小演出的考验。因此，它成为了很多大师的最爱，像 David Gilmour、 Pete Townshend 和 Ronnie Wood 等人都用它创造了自己的传奇音色。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量/后级增益
Presence： 调节音箱音色临场度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Hiwatt® DR103* （Normal 通道）的音箱模拟。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Hiwatt® DR103* amp head (NORMAL channel).

This is an amp simulator based on the Gibson® Scout* amp, a rare vintage amp with a smooth vintage clean sound.

Alg.Name: Jazz Clean
Alg.descriptionEN:
The legendary Solid sound.
Our Jazz Clean is based on the immaculate "JC clean" 2x12 solid-state jazz-amp combo. The pure transparent clean sound has ruled for more than four decades and remains incontestably reliable among pro musicians.

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bright: Switches extra presence on/off
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Alg.descriptionCN:
这个前级模拟的音色基于一款传奇的晶体管音箱： “爵士合唱”音箱。它有着纯净透明的原声，自推出以来已历经四十多年，音色之好依然是无可争议，在专业音乐人中有着极佳的口碑。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节音箱输出音量
Bright： 额外音色明亮度开关

Presence: Controls the effect headroom

Deep: Switches extra low end on/off

Alg.Name: Messe IV Lead
Alg.descriptionEN:
The classic Boogie Lead sound...and beyond.
This model is based on the legendary Mesa/Boogie® Mark IV™* amp head (LEAD channel). This massive lead tone is one of the most beautifully voiced tones that can always be heard in a mix. 

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount 
Presence: Controls the effect headroom 
Master: Controls the effect output (post gain)
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Fat: Switch on to get a fatter sound 
Bright: Switches extra brightness on/off
Voicing: Selects from two voicings: Mid Gain (a punchier sound with more mids and distortion)/Harmony (a more balanced sound)

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款音箱模拟的音色基于 Mesa/Boogie® Mark IV®* 的 Lead 通道，为您呈现出经典的 Mesa/Boogie®* 风格主奏音色。它在提供了大量失真度的同时，依然能保持声音的动态和细节。相较它的前辈而言，Mark IV®* 的声音的凹陷感更强、音色线条更加结实、硬朗。
如果您需要原版箱头上面的五段均衡，您可以加载一个EQ模块并加载 V-EQ 效果。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节音箱前级增益
Presence： 调节音箱音色临场度
Master： 调节效果输出音量/后级增益
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节音箱的低/中/高频响应
Fat： 额外中频响应开关
Bright： 额外音色明亮度开关
Voicing： 选择两种不同音色： 
-Mid Gain：  中频更突出的音色，增益较高
-Harmony： 更加平衡的音色，增益较低

Alg.Name: Power Amp
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is a tube power amp simulator with various tonal controls. 

Controls:

Tube Type: Selects from different power tube types:
-6L6: Commonly found in many US style amps
-EL34: Commonly found in many UK style amps 
-EL84: Commonly found in some classic Class-A amps
-6V6: Commonly found in some legendary low powered US combo amps
-KT66: Commonly found in early UK Plexi-style amps and some boutique amps
-KT88: Commonly found in boutique/modern hi gain amps and bass amps
-6550: Commonly found in bass amps
Depth: Controls the effect depth
Presence: Controls the effect headroom
Sag: Turn up to reduce power supply voltage to create a compression feel
B+ Response: Controls the B+ voltage for a looser (turn up)/faster (turn down) picking response
Negative FB: Controls the negative feedback amount; turn up to get a quieter tone
Output: Controls the effect output
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一款后级模拟效果，有着多样化的参数和调节范围。

参数控制： 

Tube Type： 选择电子管类型：
-6L6： 常见于美式音箱
-EL34： 常见于英式音箱
-EL84： 常见于一些经典的 Class A 音箱
-6V6： 常见于一些经典的美式小功率一体音箱
-KT66： 常见于一些早期的英式 Plexi 音箱或一些发烧音箱上
-KT88： 常见于一些发烧音箱、现代高增益音箱或贝斯音箱上
-6550： 常见于贝斯音箱
Depth： 调节后级低频响应
Presence：  调节后级临场度
Sag： 调节后级变压器电压值，调大以降低电压值，从而获得更有压缩感的声音
B+ Response：  调节B+电压以增加（调小）或减少（调大）拨弦响应速度
Negative FB：  调节负反馈大小，调大以获得更安静的声音/更低的失真度
Output： 控制后级输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 一款后级模拟效果。

Use the five bands above to control the EQ level.

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个基于 Mesa/Boogie® Mark™* 系列音箱上5段图形均衡模块的均衡效果。

参数控制： 

80Hz、240Hz、750Hz、2200Hz、6600Hz： 提升或衰减对应的频段

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Mesa/Boogie® Mark™* 系列音箱上5段图形均衡模块的均衡效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Mesa/Boogie®* 5-band graphic EQ module found on Mesa/Boogie® Mark™* Series amps.

Alg.Name: Graphic 7
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 7-band equalizer based on a widely used white guitar EQ pedal with max. ±15dB boost/cut range. You can use this EQ to control your sound, eliminate unwanted feedback, and expand your tone.

Controls: 

Band 1: 100Hz
Band 2: 200Hz
Band 3: 400Hz
Band 4: 800Hz
Band 5: 1.6kHz
Band 6: 3.2kHz
Band 7: 6.4kHz
Use the seven bands above to control the center frequency.
Level: Controls the output level by ±15dB
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款均衡效果基于某款被广泛使用的白色吉他7段图形均衡 （Graphic EQ） 单块。

参数控制： 

100Hz、200Hz、400Hz、800Hz、1.6kHz、3.2kHz、6.4kHz： 提升或衰减对应的频段
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 基于某款被广泛使用的白色吉他7段图形均衡单块。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 7-band equalizer based on a widely used white guitar EQ pedal.

Alg.Name: Graphic 7B
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 7-band bass equalizer based on a widely used white bass EQ pedal with max. ±15dB boost/cut range. You can use this EQ to control your sound, eliminate unwanted feedback, and expand your tone.

Controls: 

Band 1: 50Hz
Band 2: 120Hz
Band 3: 400Hz
Band 4: 500Hz
Band 5: 800kHz
Band 6: 4.5kHz
Band 7: 10kHz
Use the seven bands above to control the center frequency.
Level: Controls the output level by ±15dB
Alg.descriptionCN:
这款均衡效果基于某款被广泛使用的白色贝斯7段图形均衡 （Graphic EQ） 单块。

参数控制： 

50Hz、120Hz、400Hz、500Hz、800Hz、4.5kHz、10kHz： 提升或衰减对应的频段
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 基于某款被广泛使用的白色贝斯7段图形均衡单块。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 7-band bass equalizer based on a widely used white bass EQ pedal.

Alg.Name: Para EQ 1
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 4-band parametric equalizer with low/high shelving filters that suitable for any instrument. 

Controls: 

Band 1: 20Hz-2000Hz
Band 2, 3: 100Hz-10kHz
Band 4: 200Hz-20kHz
Use the four bands above to control the center frequency.
Q 1-4: Controls the Q bandwidth
Gain 1-4: Controls the EQ level by ±12dB
Lo/Hi Shelf: Controls the overall low/high EQ level by ±12dB
Level: Controls the output level
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个带有两个搁架（Shelf）滤波器和四个可调频段的参量均衡 （Parametric EQ）， 有着极强的音色可塑性，适用于任何乐器。

参数控制： 

Band X （X=1-4）：  调节频段X的中心频点位置
Q X （X=1-4）：  调节频段X的Q值
Gain X （X=1-4）：  调节频段X的提升/削减范围（±12dB）
Lo/Hi Shelf：  整体提升或衰减低频/高频（±12dB）
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 带有两个搁架（Shelf）滤波器和四个可调频段的参量均衡。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 4-band parametric equalizer with low/high shelving filters that suitable for any instrument.

Alg.Name: Para EQ 2
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 5-band parametric equalizer with selectable filter types that suitable for any instrument. 
Band 3 filter shape is fixed to Peak. 

Controls: 

Freq 1-5: Controls the filter center frequency:
-Freq 1: 20Hz-2000Hz
-Freq 2, 3, 4: 100Hz-10kHz
-Freq 5: 200Hz-20kHz
Q 1-5: Controls the Q bandwidth
Gain 1-5: Controls the EQ level by ±12dB
Band 1/2/4/5 Type: Controls the band 1/2/4/5 filter shape: 
-Band 1/5: Lo/Hi Cut, Lo/Hi Shelf, Peak
-Band 2/4: Lo/Hi Shelf, Peak
Level: Controls the output level
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个带有五个可调频段的参量均衡 （Parametric EQ）， 有着极强的音色可塑性，适用于任何乐器。

参数控制： 

Band X Type （X=1、2、4、5）：  调节频段X的滤波器类型： 搁架（Shelf）、低高切（Lo/Hi Cut， 仅频段1和5）、波峰（Peak）
Freq 1-5：  调节频段X的中心频点位置
Q X （X=1-4）：  调节频段X的Q值
Gain X （X=1-4）：  调节频段X的提升/削减范围（±12dB）
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 带有五个可调频段的参量均衡。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 5-band parametric equalizer with selectable filter types that suitable for any instrument.

Alg.Name: Graphic EQ
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a 10-band equalizer suitable for any instrument. 

Controls: 

Band 1: 31Hz
Band 2: 63Hz 
Band 3: 125Hz
Band 4: 250Hz
Band 5: 500Hz
Band 6: 1kHz
Band 7: 2kHz
Band 8: 4kHz
Band 9: 8kHz
Band 10: 16kHz
Use the ten bands above to control the EQ level by ±12dB.
Level: Controls the output level
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个10段图形均衡 （Graphic EQ）， 有着极强的音色可塑性，适用于任何乐器。

参数控制： 
31Hz～16kHz： 提升或衰减对应的频段（±12dB）
Level： 调节效果输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 10段图形均衡。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a 10-band equalizer suitable for any instrument.

Alg.Name: Aozora Chorus
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

Based on the legendary Arion® SCH-1 Stereo Chorus* pedal, this Aozora chorus brings you a beautiful 80s vibe, everything from classic chorus to killer rotary effects. Clapton and Landau loved this sound. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:
Depth: Controls the chorus depth
Rate: Controls the chorus speed
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Aozora Chorus 基于 Arion® SCH-1* 立体声合唱单块，它有着 Eric Clapton 和 Michael Landau 最爱的80年代的美妙音色。您还可以用它创造类似旋转扬声器风格的音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Arion® SCH-1* 立体声合唱单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Arion® SCH-1 Stereo Chorus* pedal.

Alg.Name: Grand Choruium
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

Based on the chorus mode of legendary 1970s ensemble chorus pedal, the Grand Choruium provides that timeless dreamy, warm, shimmering vintage analog chorus sound that musicians dream of.  
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the chorus depth
Rate: Controls the chorus speed
Output: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Grand Choruium 的音色基于合唱界的传奇： 它出生于70年代，是众多乐手梦寐以求的名机；它块头巨大，有 Chorus/Vibrato 两个模式可选。 Grand Choruium 忠实重现了原版 Chorus 档温暖、泛音丰富、梦幻般的模拟合唱之声。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于70年代合唱界的传奇，块头巨大，有 Chorus/Vibrato 两个模式可选。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the chorus mode of legendary 1970s ensemble chorus pedal.

Alg.Name: Liquid C
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

Based on the legendary 4-button stereo chorus pedal, this Liquid C is more of a "dimension expander" than a chorus effect. Offering 4 finely tuned modes, this model adds unique spatial elements and subtle modulations to which nothing can compare.

Controls:

Mode: Select from 4 different chorus modes
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Liquid C 的声音基于一块传奇的紫色四按键立体声合唱单块效果器，它每一种合唱模式都有丰富的细节和极强的空间感，可以大大扩展您声音的广度。

参数控制： 

Mode： 选择四个不同的合唱模式
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一块传奇的紫色四按键立体声合唱单块效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary 4-button stereo chorus pedal.

Alg.Name: Bass Chorus
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This vintage-voiced chorus model is based on the famous ensemble chorus unit that tuned for bass players. Like its cousin, the Choruium B gives you a pure, lush tone. Individual effect level control offers more flexibility for bass.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the vibrato depth
Rate: Controls the vibrato rate
Output: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个贝斯合唱效果，它基于某个经典贝斯合唱单块建模而来。作为最早在市面上出现的贝斯专用合唱单块，它能够带给您自然、纯正、丰富的合唱音色，并且独立的效果音量调节可以让声音细节更加多样化。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于某个经典贝斯合唱单块建模而来。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the famous ensemble chorus unit that tuned for bass players.

Alg.Name: Liquid Dream
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is based on the legendary Voodoo Lab® Analog Chorus* pedal. Offering you warm, organic sound and lush harmonics, it has become the standard by which all chorus pedals are measured. Fine tune the two parameters to get your own sound, from subtle doubling to sweet rotation!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Selects the chorus depth from deep to shallow
Rate: Controls the chorus speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Liquid Dream 的音色基于 Voodoo Lab® Analog Chorus* 单块效果器，有着温暖细腻的合唱音色，并且有着丰富的泛音和细节。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Voodoo Lab® Analog Chorus* 单块效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Voodoo Lab® Analog Chorus* pedal.

Alg.Name: 3D Chorus
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This is a multi-dimensional chorus model with independent depth controls for each audio channel (center, left and right). This super lush model will give you the real 3D experience for your ears (especially on stereo sound systems!).
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Rate: Controls the chorus speed
Filter: Controls the effect tone
Depth L/C/R: Controls the chorus depth of left/right/center channels
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个多维合唱效果，每一个声道（左/中/右）的合唱深度都可以独立控制，这种3D的声音效果能让您完全置身于所弹奏的音乐中。该效果在立体声系统中使用时效果更佳！
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节干湿信号比例
Depth L/C/R：  控制左中右声道的合唱深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Filter： 调节音色明亮度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 多维合唱效果，每一个声道（左/中/右）的合唱深度都可以独立控制。
Alg.desInforEN: A multi-dimensional chorus model with independent depth controls for each audio channel.

Alg.Name: Flanger
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model produces the classic flanging effect originally achieved by manually, independently varying the speed of two tape recorders with the same program material. It produces a rich, natural flanging tone.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the flanger depth
Rate: Controls the flanger speed
Pre Delay: Controls the pre delay time
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个经典镶边 （Flanger） 效果，能够制造出丰富、自然的镶边音色，并且有着宽广的调节范围。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Pre Delay：  调节预延迟时间
Feedback： 调节效果反馈量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 一个经典镶边（Flanger）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Produces the classic flanging effect originally achieved by manually.

Alg.Name: Bass Flanger
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model achieves the classic flanging effect for bass players. It produces a rich, natural flanging tone. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the flanger depth
Rate: Controls the flanger speed
Pre Delay: Controls the pre delay time
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个为贝斯手设计的经典镶边 （Flanger） 效果，能够制造出丰富、自然的镶边音色，并且有着宽广的调节范围。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Pre Delay： 调节预延迟时间
Feedback： 调节效果反馈量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 为贝斯手设计的经典镶边（Flanger）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Achieves the classic flanging effect for bass players.

Alg.Name: Neg Flanger
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model produces a flanger effect with negative feedback, sounds like deep in the water, very unique flanging tone.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the flanger depth
Rate: Controls the flanger speed
Pre Delay: Controls the pre delay time
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个负反馈镶边 （Negative Feedback Flanger） 效果，能够制造出如同置身水底般的镶边音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Pre Delay：  调节预延迟时间
Feedback： 调节效果反馈量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 一个负反馈镶边（Negative Feedback Flanger）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Produces a flanger effect with negative feedback.

Alg.Name: Trem Flanger
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model blended a classic flanging tone with a normal tremolo effect, you can adjust the flanger and tremolo parameters separately to get a distinctive sound.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Flg/Trm Sync switch. When the switch is on, turn the Flg/Trm Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Flg Depth: Controls the flanger depth
Flg Rate: Controls the flanger speed
Feedback: Controls the flanger feedback amount
Trm Depth: Controls the tremolo depth
Trm Rate: Controls the tremolo speed
Flg Sync: Switches flanger Tap Tempo sync on/off
Trm Sync: Switches tremolo Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个结合了震音 （Tremolo） 和镶边 （Flanger） 效果的音色。您可以通过分别调整镶边和颤音的参数以获得独特的声音。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Flg Depth/Rate：  控制镶边效果深度/速度
Trm Depth/Rate：  控制颤音效果深度/速度
Feedback： 调节效果反馈量
Flg Sync： 镶边效果打点定速同步开关
Trm Sync： 震音效果打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 结合了震音（Tremolo）和镶边（Flanger）效果的音色。
Alg.desInforEN: Blended a classic flanging tone with a normal tremolo effect.

Alg.Name: Pulser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

The Pulser is a rebirth of the super rare all-analog vintage vibrato pedal, which gives you a classic vibrato sound with true analog warmth. With simple DEPTH and RATE controls, it's easy to tweak your own unique texture, from slight vibes to a full-on wobble. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the vibrato depth
Rate: Controls the vibrato rate
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Pulser的声音基于某块经典BBD器件模拟颤音 （Analog Vibrato） 单块效果器的声音，能够带给您纯粹的模拟颤音音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于某块经典BBD器件模拟颤音（Vibrato）单块效果器的声音。
Alg.desInforEN: A rebirth of the super rare all-analog vintage vibrato pedal.

Alg.Name: Grand Vibrato
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

Based on the vibrato mode of legendary 1970s ensemble chorus pedal the Grand Vibrato provides that timeless dreamy, warm, shimmering vintage analog vibrato sound that musicians dream of.  
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the vibrato depth
Rate: Controls the vibrato rate
Output: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Grand Vibrato 的音色基于合唱界的传奇： 它出生于70年代，是众多乐手梦寐以求的名机；它块头巨大，有Chorus/Vibrato 两个模式可选。 Grand Vibrato 忠实重现了原版 Vibrato 档温暖、泛音丰富、梦幻般的模拟颤音 （Vibrato） 之声。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 控制效果深度
Rate： 控制效果速度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于70年代合唱界的传奇，块头巨大，有Chorus/Vibrato 两个模式可选。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the vibrato mode of legendary 1970s ensemble chorus pedal.

Alg.Name: Vibrato
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is a typical vibrato effect with a wide controllable range. Use the Depth knob to vary the pitch, use the Rate knob to control the modulation speed.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the vibrato depth
Rate: Controls the vibrato speed
Output: Controls the effect level
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个典型的颤音 （Vibrato） 效果，为您的声音加入音调变化。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 一个典型的颤音（Vibrato）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A typical vibrato effect with a wide controllable range.

Alg.Name: Vibrato T
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This is a special vibrato effect with dynamic depth control, which lets you create  touch-sensitive pitch modulation. Use the Rate knob to control the modulation speed; use the Sens knob to fine tune the sensitivity.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Sens: Controls the effect sensitivity
Rate: Controls the vibrato speed
Output: Controls the effect level
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个特殊的颤音 （Vibrato） 效果，它的颤音深度由您的演奏力度控制，力度越大，颤音深度越浅。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Sens： 调节效果灵敏度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Output： 调节效果输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 特殊的颤音（Vibrato）效果，它的颤音深度由您的演奏力度控制。
Alg.desInforEN: A special vibrato effect with dynamic depth control.

Alg.Name: 90 Phaser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

The 90 Phaser recreates the warm, rich analog phase sound of the legendary MXR® M101 Phase 90* pedal. Born in 1974, the one-knob orange phaser is an icon that has found a place on millions of pedal boards for over four decades.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Rate: Controls the phaser speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

90 Phaser 的效果基于鼎鼎大名的 MXR® M101 Phase 90* ——大家公认的相位效果器标杆。从70年代末开始，它温暖丰富的声音就不断出现在大量的唱片当中。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于鼎鼎大名的 MXR® M101 Phase 90* 相位效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary MXR® M101 Phase 90* pedal.

Alg.Name: Green Phaser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This Green Phaser produces a sharp phase effect with a wide range from very slow to fast speed. This unique phasing sound has become popular among lots of musicians since 1977.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the phaser depth
Rate: Controls the phaser speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Green Phaser 的声音基于某款经典两钮绿色相位单块效果器，为您带来温暖、通透的音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 基于某款经典两钮绿色相位单块效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Produces a sharp phase effect with a wide range from very slow to fast speed.

Alg.Name: Stone Phaser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

The Stone Phaser is based on the legendary and extremely rare 1970s Electro-Harmonix® Small Stone phase shifter* pedal. This original is one of the best analog phaser sounds in the history of music and can be heard on countless rock recordings. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Color: Selects the phaser sound character from warm to sharp
Rate: Controls the phaser speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Stone Phaser 的效果基于一块元年 Electro-Harmonix® Small Stone* 相位单块，它有着不可思议的效果深度。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Color： 选择声音特性： 
-Warm： 平滑温暖的音色
-Sharp： 尖锐明亮的音色
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于一块元年 Electro-Harmonix® Small Stone* 相位单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the 1970s Electro-Harmonix® Small Stone phase shifter* pedal.

Alg.Name: Notch Phaser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model might be the craziest phaser ever – A phaser with 3 notch parameters! The 3 subtle Notch knobs will bring you lots of phasing combos from vintage, warm sounding to modern, sharp sounding. Create your own inspiration!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the phaser depth
Rate: Controls the phaser speed
Level: Controls the effect level
Notch 1-3: Controls the notch bandwidth of 3 different frequencies
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这个相位效果自带3个陷波滤波器 （Notch Filter） 参数调节，有着夸张的音色调节范围。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Notch 1-3：  控制3个陷波滤波器的中心频率
Level： 调节效果的输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 自带3个陷波滤波器（Notch Filter）的相位效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A phaser with 3 notch parameters.

Alg.Name: Pan Phaser
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This is a special phaser that combines tremolo/pan variations. Featuring subtle, bright phasing tone and smooth panning tone, you get some seriously trippy psychedelic mojo here. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Phs/Pan Sync switches. When the switch is on, turn the Pan/Phaser Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Pan Depth: Controls the tremolo depth (using mono output) or panning depth (using stereo output)
Pan Rate: Controls the tremolo speed (using mono output) or panning speed (using stereo output)
Phaser Depth: Controls the phaser depth
Phaser Rate: Controls the phaser speed
Phs Sync: Switches phaser Tap Tempo sync on/off
Pan Sync: Switches tremolo/pan Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一个极具特色的相位效果，当您使用单声道输出时，将可以获得明亮、微妙的相位效果以及平滑的震音（Tremolo/Pan）效果，而使用立体声输出时，除了相位效果外，声音还会在左右声道来回摆动。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Phaser Depth：  调节相位效果速度
Phaser Rate：  调节相位效果速度
Pan Depth：  调节震音效果深度（使用单声道输出）或者左右声相摆动的幅度（使用立体声输出）
Pan Rate：  调节震音效果速度（使用单声道输出）或者左右声相摆动效果的速度（使用立体声输出）
Phs Sync：  相位效果打点定速同步开关
Pan Sync：  震音效果打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 极具特色的相位效果，除了相位效果外，声音还会在左右声道来回摆动。
Alg.desInforEN: A special phaser that combines tremolo/pan variations.

Alg.Name: Minivibe
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model delivers a lush rotating effect that simulates 1960s rotary speakers. Based on the Voodoo Lab® Micro Vibe*, it gives you the pure, "psychedelic" vibe-y taste that guitar heroes like Hendrix and Gilmour loved.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the effect depth
Rate: Controls the effect speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Minivibe 的音色基于 Voodoo Lab® Micro Vibe* 单块效果器，重现了上世纪60年代的旋转扬声器模拟单块风格的效果。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Voodoo Lab® Micro Vibe* 旋转扬声器模拟单块效果器。
Alg.desInforEN: Delivers a lush rotating effect that simulates 1960s rotary speakers.

Alg.Name: Revolver
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

The Revolver is based on the legendary vintage Shin-ei® Uni-Vibe®* pedal. The Uni-Vibe®* was designed to simulate the sound of a rotary speaker, but the "failed" attempt has been embraced as one of the most iconic effects in rock 'n' roll history. Kick it on and feel the legendary psycho sound of the Revolver!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the effect depth
Rate: Controls the effect speed
Volume: Controls the effect output
Mode: Select from 2 different vibe modes: Chorus and Vibrato 
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off 
*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Revolver 的声音基于 Shin-ei® Uni-Vibe®* 单块，一块最初想要模拟旋转扬声器的音色的效果器，但是它开辟了另外一片独特的声音领域，甚至这类效果以这个效果器的名字命名。自它诞生的那一刻起，一段传奇拉开了序幕： 大量摇滚乐先驱开始使用Uni-Vibe®*来实现更丰富的音色表现，随着 Jimi Hendrix、 David Gilmour 等大师在音乐当中的运用，它对后世产生了深远的影响。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Volume： 调节输出音量
Mode： 选择工作模式： Chorus（合唱模式）和Vibrato（颤音模式）
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于 Shin-ei® Uni-Vibe®* 模拟旋转扬声器单块。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary vintage Shin-ei® Uni-Vibe®* pedal.

Alg.Name: Helicopter
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is based on the legendary Demeter® TRM-1 Tremulator®* tremolo pedal. Featuring deep, pulsing optical tremolo sound, it recreates the classic tremolo effect found on many vintage amps but with a greater range of speed and depth.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the tremolo depth
Rate: Controls the tremolo speed
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Helicopter 是一个音色基于传奇的 Demeter® TRM-1 Tremulator* 的震音 （Tremolo） 效果，它能够带给您平滑、温暖且富有弹性的光电震音音色。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度
Rate： 调节效果速度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 基于传奇的 Demeter® TRM-1 Tremulator* 的震音（Tremolo）效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Based on the legendary Demeter® TRM-1 Tremulator®* tremolo pedal.

Alg.Name: Custom Trem
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

With 4 different waveforms to choose from, Custom Trem will be the all-star of all your tremolo pedals. The Color and Shape knobs ensure super wide tonal range and flavor.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Rate knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Depth: Controls the tremolo depth
Rate: Controls the tremolo speed
Volume: Controls the effect output
Color: Controls the tremolo tone
Shape: Selects the waveforms from sine wave, triangle wave, square wave and sawtooth wave 
Bias: Controls the bias/offset of different waveforms
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

Custom Trem 是一个有着高度可玩性的震音 （Tremolo） 效果，它提供了4种可选波形。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Rate 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Depth： 调节效果深度 
Rate： 调节效果速度
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Color： 调节震音音色
Shape： 选择波形： 正弦波 (Sine)、三角波 (Triangle)、方波 (Square) 、锯齿波（Sawtooth)
Bias： 调节波形的偏移变化
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Alg.desInforCN: 有着高度可玩性的震音（Tremolo）效果，它提供了4种可选波形。
Alg.desInforEN: Custom tremolo with 4 different waveforms to choose from.

Alg.Name: Rotary
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features mono (L) in, stereo out configuration.  

This model is a rotary speaker simulator with detailed control, bringing you the legendary tone adapted by lots of rock legends. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the effect speed by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Bass/Horn Speed knobs to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio 
Bass/Horn speed: Controls the bass/horn rotating speed
B. /H. Intensity: Controls the bass/horn intensity
Balance: Controls the bass/horn sound balance
Pan: Controls the effect L/R panning 
Tone: Controls the effect tone 
Bass/Horn Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个单声道（左声道）输入、立体声输出的效果。

这是一款旋转扬声器模拟效果，为您带来众多大师录制的唱片中出现的独特音色。它有着丰富的控制参数，您可以通过这些参数仔细雕琢效果细节。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制效果速度。打开 Sync 开关后， Bass/Horn Speed 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节效果干湿信号比
Bass/Horn Speed：  调节低音喇叭/高音号角旋转速度
B. /H. Intensity：  调节低音喇叭/高音号角效果深度
Balance： 调节低音喇叭和高音号角音量平衡
Pan： 调节效果立体声左右声相
Tone： 调节效果音色明亮度
