Alg.desInforCN: 一款旋转扬声器模拟效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A rotary speaker simulator with detailed control.

Alg.Name: Classic Stereolizer
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.  

This model is a stereo expander based on Precedence Effect which delays the right output a bit to create an expanded stereo sound. 

Controls:

Width: Controls the stereo expansion width
Phase Reverse: Switches phase reversing on/off on each channel
Level L/R: Controls the L/R channels output
Output: Controls the overall output
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这是一款立体声扩展效果，您可以用它来扩展声音的维度，使声音听起来更宽广。它会将您的右声道信号稍微延迟一点，以达到扩展声音广度的目标。

参数控制： 

Width： 调节立体声声场扩散宽度
Phase Reverse：  用于反转左右声道的声音相位，以解决可能出现的由相位抵消导致的声音不正常的问题
Level L/R： 调节左右声道输出音量
Output： 调节总输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 一款立体声扩展效果，通过将右声道信号稍微延迟，以达到扩展声音广度的目标。
Alg.desInforEN: A stereo expander.

Alg.Name: Modern Stereolizer
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.  

This model is a stereo expander based on modern methods which creates an expanded stereo sound without phasing problems. Please note we don't recommend to apply this with one side of a stereo output of an effect module.

Controls:

Width: Controls the stereo expansion width
Depth: Controls the effect depth
Low Cut/High Cut: Cuts the effect low/high signal
Output: Controls the overall output
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这是一款立体声扩展效果，您可以用它来扩展声音的维度，使声音听起来更宽广。它不会有相位抵消的问题，但是我们不推荐将它加载到立体声效果输出的单一声道上，这样可能会导致声音不正常。

参数控制： 

Width： 调节立体声声场扩散宽度
Depth： 调节效果深度
Low Cut/High Cut：  调节低频/高频衰减程度
Output： 调节总输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 一款立体声扩展效果，使用现代算法实现。

Alg.Name: Stereo Expander
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.  

This is a virtual soundstage creator for expanding stereo dimensions. We recommend using this effect after an effect with stereo outputs (e.g. stereo delays and reverbs).

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount 
Width: Controls the stereo expansion width
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这是一款立体声声场扩展效果，通过增加额外的声场，使声音听起来更宽广。我们建议将此效果加载在立体声输出效果之后使用。

Alg.desInforCN: 一款立体声声场扩展效果，通过增加额外的声场，使声音听起来更宽广。

Alg.Name: Sweller
Alg.descriptionEN:
This model is auto swell effect that creating a violin-like tone. Two parameters make it simple.  

Controls:

Attack: Controls how fast the effect swells the input signal 
Curve: Selects the volume swell curve
Side Chain: Selects side chain key input source; please set this parameter carefully to match the actual input you're using, or the effect may not work properlly: 
-Input L/R: Input jacks
-FX RTN L/R: FX Loop return jack
-Prev FX: Output signal of previous effect slot
-USB OUT 3-8: USB output 3-8; when reamping, set up according to the USB output channel you're using
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一款慢发音效果，有着简单易用的参数，可以使您的吉他发出类似小提琴的音色。

参数控制： 

Attack： 调节慢发音音量渐变速度
Curve： 选择音量渐变曲线 （线性变化、指数型变化、对数型变化）  
Side Chain： 选择侧链控制的探测信号源，请注意如果该参数设置与您实际使用的输入源不匹配时可能会导致效果功能异常：
-Input L/R： 左/右输入接口
-FX RTN L/R： 效果回路返回左/右声道
-Prev FX：  前一个效果槽的输出信号
-USB Out 3-8： USB输出3-8， 如果您需要进行Reamp， 请将此参数值设置为自己实际使用的USB输出通道
Alg.desInforCN: 一款慢发音效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This model is auto swell effect that creating a violin-like tone.

Alg.Name: Freeze
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a sound freeze/infinite sustain effect, capable of holding the sound activated at the moment of activation. You can use the footswitch's effects slot function to activate the freeze effect, and enabling the Momentary parameter turns the footswitch function into momentary type (the effect is activated when the footswitch is pressed down and deactivated when released).

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output volume
Attack: Controls the speed of the effect volume fade-in
Release: Controls the speed of the effect volume fade-out
Activate: Effect activation switch; each time Freeze effect is selected, Activate will default to off, and when switching to Scene 1, Activate will also default to remain off; when any footswitch function is set to effects slot function and associated with the effect slot containing the Freeze effect, this footswitch will directly control the Activate on/off switch rather than the effect module on/off switch
Momentary: Momentary type function switch, only applicable to footswitches 1-5, footswitches 6/7 can only execute latching type function (effect is activated when footswitch is pressed down, and deactivated when pressed down again)
Resolution: Switches the effect resolution. When selecting "High", it is recommended to place this effect's module at the front end of the effects chain for use
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一款声音冻结/无限延音效果，能够冻结住效果激活瞬间的声⾳，使其保持播放。您可以使用踩钉的效果槽开关功能来激活冻结效果，开启Momentary参数能使踩钉功能变为瞬时型（当踩钉踩下时效果激活，松开时效果关闭）。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Attack： 调节效果音量渐入速度  
Release： 调节效果音量渐出速度
Activate： 效果激活开关；每次选择到Freeze效果时，Activate会默认关闭，切换到场景1时Activate也会默认保持关闭；当任一踩钉功能设置为效果槽开关并关联Freeze效果所在的效果槽位时，该踩钉将会直接控制Activate开关而不是效果模块开关
Momentary： 瞬时型功能开关，功能仅对踩钉1-5生效，踩钉6/7只能执行自锁型功能（踩钉踩下效果激活，再次踩下效果关闭）
Resolution：  选择效果解析度， 当选择高解析度（High）时建议将此效果模块置于效果链最前端使用
Alg.desInforCN: 一款声音冻结/无限延音效果。
Alg.desInforEN: This is a sound freeze/infinite sustain effect.

Alg.Name: Feedback
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a amplifier feedback/howling simulation effect that generates controllable and natural feedback sustain based on your settings.
You can use the footswitch's effects slot function to activate the feedback effect, and enabling the Momentary parameter turns the footswitch function into momentary type (the effect is activated when the footswitch is pressed down and deactivated when released).

Controls:

Volume: Controls the effect output volume
Attack: Controls the speed of the effect volume fade-in
Type: Selects Feedback Harmonic type
-Sub: Feedback of the low octave harmonic
-1st/2nd/3rd/5th: Feedback of the first/second/third/fifth harmonic
-NAT Low/NAT High: Natural feedback with harmonic order determined by factors including playing style and pickup position
DRY: Selects whether to output the dry signal
Activate: Effect activation switch; when any footswitch function is set to effects slot function and associated with the effect slot containing the Feedback effect, this footswitch will directly control the Activate on/off switch rather than the effect module on/off switch
Momentary: Momentary type function switch, only applicable to footswitches 1-5, footswitches 6/7 can only execute latching type function (effect is activated when footswitch is pressed down, and deactivated when pressed down again)
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一款音箱回授/啸叫模拟效果，它能够根据您的设置，产生可控的、自然的回授延音。
您可以使用踩钉的效果槽开关功能来激活回授效果，开启Momentary参数能使踩钉功能变为瞬时型（当踩钉踩下时效果激活，松开时效果关闭）。

参数控制： 

Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Attack： 调节效果音量渐入速度  
Type： 选择回授谐波类型
-Sub： 低八度谐波的回授效果
-1st/2nd/3rd/5th： 一次/二次/三次/五次谐波的回授效果
-NAT Low/NAT High： 由演奏手法，拾音器档位等因素确定谐波阶次的自然的回授效果
Dry： 选择是否输出干信号
Activate： 效果激活开关；当任一踩钉功能设置为效果槽开关并关联Feedback效果所在的效果槽位时，该踩钉将会直接控制Acticate开关而不是效果模块开关
Momentary： 瞬时型功能开关，功能仅对踩钉1-5生效，踩钉6/7只能执行自锁型功能（踩钉踩下效果激活，再次踩下效果关闭）
Alg.desInforCN: 一款音箱回授/啸叫模拟效果。
Alg.desInforEN: Amp feedback/howling simulation effect

Alg.Name: Analog Delay M
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a mono analog delay model that captures the sound of a vintage analog delay machine: warm and natural, just like old times!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the delay time by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Time knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Time: Controls the delay time 
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Trail: Switched effect trail on/off when the effect is bypassed
Alg.descriptionCN:
这是一个单声道延迟效果，有着温暖、平滑的模拟延迟之声，同时也有不错的清晰度。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制延迟时间。打开 Sync 开关后， Time 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节干湿信号比例
Time： 调节延迟时间
Feedback： 调节延迟反馈量
Level： 调节输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Trail： 效果尾音保留开关，打开此开关在效果关闭后效果尾音会自然衰减而不是直接消失
Alg.desInforCN: 一个单声道模拟延迟效果。

Alg.Name: Tape Delay M
Alg.descriptionEN:
Back in the old days, producers and engineers created delay and echo effects using tape machines. That sweet, space-like echo tone is still popular today, especially among psychedelic musicians.  
This is a mono delay model that captures the characteristics of the sound of a tape echo machine. Just plug in and play, and time flows back!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the delay time by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Time knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback

Back in the old days, producers and engineers created delay and echo effects using tape machines. That sweet, space-like echo tone is still popular today, especially among psychedelic musicians.  
This is a stereo delay model that captures the characteristics of the sound of a tape echo machine. Just plug in and play, and time flows back!
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the delay time by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Time knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division).

This model is a complex delay features 4 delay lines and a feedback matrix, generating an ethereal, shimmering delay effect.  
1, 2 stands for different tonal variations.
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the delay time by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Time knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is: Time 1=1/4 (no division), Time 2=1/8, Time 3=1/8D, Time 4=1/4D. 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Time 1-4: Controls the delay 1-4 time 
Level 1-4: Controls the delay 1-4 output
Pan 1-4: Controls the delay 1-4 L/R panning
Output: Controls the overall output
Mod: Controls the effect modulation amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Sync: Switches delay 1-4 Tap Tempo sync on/off
Trail: Switched effect trail on/off when the effect is bypassed
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这个延迟效果有着复杂的内部结构和多达四条的延迟线 （Delay Line）， 您可以用它做出华丽而绵延不绝的延迟效果，甚至可以用来模拟混响效果。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制延迟时间。打开 Sync 开关后， Time 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认参数为： Time 1 =1/4（不分拍），Time 2 =1/8，Time 3 =1/8D，Time 4 =1/4D。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节干湿信号比例
Output： 调节总输出音量
Feedback： 调节延迟反馈量
Time 1-4：  分别调节延迟1-4的延迟时间
Level 1-4：  分别调节延迟1-4的输出音量
Pan 1-4：  分别调节延迟1-4的立体声相位
Mod： 调节效果音中调制效果的量
Tone： 调节音色明亮度
Sync： 打点定速同步开关，同时影响四条延迟线
Trail： 效果尾音保留开关，打开此开关在效果关闭后效果尾音会自然衰减而不是直接消失
Alg.desInforCN: 有着复杂的内部结构和多达四条的延迟线（Delay Line）的延迟效果。
Alg.desInforEN: A complex delay features 4 delay lines and a feedback matrix.

Alg.Name: Icy Delay
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.  

This is a special delay effect that combining normal feedback with pitch shifted slices. 
You can use Tap Tempo function to control the delay time by turning on the Sync switch. When the Sync switch is on, turn the Time knob to set a proper tap divide value. The default value is 1/4 (no division). 

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio 
Time: Controls the delay time
Feedback: Controls the amount of feedback
Mod: Controls the effect modulation amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Pitch: Selects pitch shifting interval of the slices
Slice: Choose audio signal slicing length
Direction: Controls audio slice playback direction
Blend: Controls the ratio between normal/pitch shifted feedback
Smooth: Controls the feedback attack
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Trail: Switched effect trail on/off when the effect is bypassed
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这是一款特殊的延迟效果，它的效果音内混合了常规延迟效果音和经过移调、切片处理后的延迟效果音。
您可以通过打开 Sync 开关以使用打点定速功能控制延迟时间。打开 Sync 开关后， Time 参数的功能变为控制打点分拍的比值，默认是1/4（不分拍）。

参数控制： 

Mix： 调节效果混合度 
Time： 调节延迟时间
Feedback： 调节延迟反馈量
Mod： 调节效果音中调制效果的量
Tone： 调节效果音色明亮度
Pitch：调节切片效果音移调音程
Slice：调节切片效果音长度
Direction：调节切片效果音回放方向
Blend：调节常规延迟效果音和切片效果音的混合比
Smooth：调节效果音音头
Level： 调节总输出音量
Sync： 打点定速同步开关
Trail： 效果尾音保留开关，打开此开关在效果关闭后效果尾音会自然衰减而不是直接消失
Alg.desInforCN: 混合了常规延迟效果音和经过移调、切片处理后的延迟效果音。
Alg.desInforEN: Combining normal feedback with pitch shifted slices.

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio 
Time: Controls the delay time

Crossfeed: Controls slice 1/2 (L/R) crossfeed amount
Level: Controls the effect output
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
Trail: Switched effect trail on/off when the effect is bypassed

Alg.desInforEN: Creates a huge, lush reverb effect like silver linings of clouds in the sky.

Alg.Name: Velvet Verb HQ
Alg.descriptionEN:
Note: This effect features stereo I/O configuration.

Hotone's next-gen effect algorithms! Leading a qualitative leap in both hearing and playing.
This reverb model produces a clean, smooth reverb effect akin to the finest velvet silk in existence. The latest generation of modeling technology provides this model with a more high-quality sound.

Controls:

Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Decay: Controls the duration of reverb time
Early/Late Ref: Controls the volume of the early/late reflections of the reverb effect
Hi Damp: Dampens the effect high frequency amount
Low/Hi Pass: Removes high frequencies above and low frequencies below a specified point in the reverb effect
Mod Depth: Controls the effect modulation depth
Mod Rate: Controls the effect modulation speed
Trail: Switched effect trail on/off when the effect is bypassed

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
Alg.descriptionCN:
请注意： 这是一个立体声效果（立体声输入/输出）。

这个混响效果有着干净平滑的音色，如同上等的丝绒绸缎一般。该效果使用了我们最新一代的建模技术，带来更高品质音色。
 
参数控制： 

Mix： 调节干湿信号比例
Decay： 调节混响衰减时间
Early/Late Ref： 调节混响效果早反射/迟反射的音量大小
Hi Damp：  衰减效果高频量
Low/Hi Pass：  切除效果音在设定频点以上的高频信号或以下的低频信号
Mod Depth： 调节效果音中调制效果的深度
Mod Rate： 调节效果音中调制效果的速度
Trail： 效果尾音保留开关，打开此开关在效果关闭后效果尾音会自然衰减而不是直接消失

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
Alg.desInforCN: 最新一代算法，干净平滑的混响音色。
Alg.desInforEN: Next-gen effect algorithms produce a clean, smooth reverb effect.

Alg.Name: FX Loop Send
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is for FX Loop Send jack settings. 

Controls: 

Type: Selects the output type (channel)
Send Level: Controls the output level to FX Loop Send jack
Thru Level: Controls the output level to Ampero II Stage's signal chain (or to the next effect module); set it to Mute to use as a serial FX Loop
Alg.descriptionCN:
您可以用提供的参数来对效果回路发送 （FX Loop Send） 接口进行设置。

参数控制： 

Type： 选择输出信号类型： 仅左声道/仅右声道/立体声
Send Level：  调节输出到 FX Loop Send 接口的电平
Thru Level：  调节发送到效果链内下一模块或节点的电平，设为 Mute 时您可以将效果回路作为串联式效果回路使用，保持默认时您可以将效果回路作为并联式效果回路使用
Alg.desInforCN: 对效果回路发送接口进行设置。
Alg.desInforEN: This is for FX Loop Send jack settings.

Alg.Name: FX Loop Return
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is for FX Loop Return jack settings. 

Controls: 

Type: Selects the output type (channel)
Return Level: Controls the FX Loop return jack input level
Mix: Controls the signal ratio between the FX loop signal and the signal coming from Ampero II Stage's signal chain; set it to 100 to use as a serial FX Loop
Alg.descriptionCN:
您可以用提供的参数来对效果回路返回 （FX Loop Return） 接口进行设置。

参数控制： 

Type： 选择输入信号类型： 仅左声道/仅右声道/立体声
Return Level：  调节从 FX Loop Return 接口返回信号的信号电平
Mix：  调节从 FX Loop Return 接口返回信号和来自效果链内上一模块/节点信号的混合比，设为100时您可以将效果回路作为串联式效果回路使用
Alg.desInforCN: 对效果回路返回接口进行设置。
Alg.desInforEN: This is for FX Loop Return jack settings.

Alg.Name: FX Loop
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is for entire FX Loop settings. 

Controls: 

Type: Selects the output type (channel)
Send Level: Controls the output level to FX Loop Send jack
Return Level: Controls the FX Loop return jack input level
Mix: Controls the signal ratio between the FX loop signal and the signal coming from Ampero II Stage's signal chain; set it to 100 to use as a serial FX Loop
Alg.descriptionCN:
您可以用提供的参数来对效果回路 （FX Loop） 接口进行设置。

参数控制： 

Type： 选择效果回路信号类型： 仅左声道/仅右声道/立体声
Send Level：  调节输出到 FX Loop Send 接口的电平
Return Level：  调节从 FX Loop Return 接口返回信号的信号电平
Mix：  调节效果回路信号和效果链信号的混合比，设为100时您可以将效果回路作为串联式效果回路使用
Alg.desInforCN: 对效果回路接口进行设置。
Alg.desInforEN: This is for entire FX Loop settings.

Alg.Name: Volume
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is a simple volume controller effect that acts like a volume pedal.  
Assign the Volume parameter to your expression pedal, turn the expression pedal on, and you can use it as a volume pedal.  

Controls: 

Volume: Controls the output volume
Alg.descriptionCN:
您可以将 Volume 参数分配到表情踏板上，接入或打开表情踏板，然后您就可以将表情踏板作为音量踏板使用。

参数控制： 

Volume： 控制输出音量
Alg.desInforCN: 可以作为音量踏板使用。
Alg.desInforEN: A simple volume controller effect that acts like a volume pedal.

Alg.Name: Tone Catch 1
Alg.descriptionEN:
This is for loading Tone Catch file by clicking "Tone Catch Manage" button.

Controls:

Gain: Controls the gain amount
Volume: Controls the effect output
Bass/Middle/Treble: 3-band EQ that controls the effect tone
Alg.descriptionCN:
本栏位用于加载音色捕捉（Tone Catch）文件，点击“音色文件管理”按钮即可加载。

参数控制： 

Gain： 调节效果增益
Volume： 调节效果输出音量
Bass/Middle/Treble： 三段均衡调节效果的低/中/高频响应
Alg.desInforCN: 用于加载音色文件。
Alg.desInforEN: Shot for loading Tone file.
